text_a: I was navigating the roundabout near the Casa da Música, trying to exit towards Avenida da Boavista. The traffic was quite heavy as it was around 6:00 PM. I was in the middle lane when the driver in the outer lane suddenly cut across to exit early, and I couldn't avoid contact. There is a noticeable dent on my front passenger door and a long scratch along the side panel. Honestly, I'm just so stressed about this whole ordeal, I really didn't expect this to happen while just heading home after work, you know?
text_b: I was traveling in the middle lane when I signaled to move to the right. I must have had a blind spot because I didn't see the van coming up beside me. As I began to shift, we made contact. It wasn't a high-speed collision, just a side-swipe. I have a dent on my front fender and a series of deep scratches along the side door panel. I am a professional driver and I usually pay closer attention, so I am quite frustrated with my own lack of awareness today.

text_a: I was backing up very slowly when I tapped a light pole in the car park. It was barely a touch, but I need to report it. Actually, looking at the car now, the entire rear bumper assembly has detached, the tail lights are non-functional, and the rear quarter panel is buckling from the kinetic energy. It is quite a disaster and will require a full professional overhaul of the entire rear section.
text_b: I saw the guy reverse into the pole. It made a very soft thud. I checked the back of the car, and I only see a minor surface scratch on the bumper plastic.

text_a: I was driving in the right lane, and a large truck was in the lane to my left. As we were moving, the truck started to drift into my lane. I swerved to the right to avoid a major collision, but I still clipped the side barrier. This resulted in a long scratch along my passenger side doors. It was quite a stressful experience, and my hands were shaking for a while afterward, but I managed to keep the car under control.
text_b: I was standing near the metro exit when I saw the truck drift into the lane of the BMW. The BMW driver reacted well by moving to the right, but they were forced against the guardrail. I saw the side of the BMW get scratched by the barrier. It was clearly the truck's fault for drifting, but thankfully it was only a scratch and not a more serious accident.

text_a: I parked my car on the side of the road to go visit a friend at the university. When I returned about two hours later, I noticed a fresh, long scratch on my rear bumper. There was no note left by the other driver, but looking at the paint transfer, it seems like a metallic blue car grazed me while trying to squeeze into the spot behind me. It is incredibly frustrating to find this when you come back. I just want to get it fixed so the car stays in good condition.
text_b: I was sitting at the cafe across the street and saw a blue car try to park behind the Golf. The driver misjudged the space and scraped the bumper of the Golf. They got out, looked at the damage, then just got back in and drove away quickly. I didn't get their license plate, but I clearly saw the scratch being made.

text_a: THIS IS RIDICULOUS! I WAS STOPPED AT THE LIGHT AND SOME IDIOT NUDGED ME FROM BEHIND. IT'S A CLEAR DENT, BUT I ALSO SEE A CRACK ON MY BUMPER AND MY TAIL LAMP IS BROKEN! THIS IS A SCANDAL! I DEMAND IMMEDIATE ATTENTION AND REPAIR! IF THIS IS NOT RESOLVED FAST, I WILL CALL MY LAWYERS AND FILE A COMPLAINT WITH THE 'LIVRO DE RECLAMAÇÕES'! DON'T WASTE MY TIME!
text_b: It was a very minor tap. The traffic started and then stopped again almost instantly. My foot slipped off the clutch, and I rolled forward a tiny bit, making contact with the Peugeot. I saw only a small dent on their bumper. Definitely no crack or broken lamp. The driver was quite agitated, though.

text_a: Oh, I feel absolutely terrible about this. The traffic near the center was so dense, and for just a second, I looked at my GPS to find the turn. When I looked back, the car in front had stopped, and I just tapped them. I'm shaking because I've never had a collision before. Is there a deductible I have to pay immediately? I want to make sure everything is handled correctly so the other gentleman isn't inconvenienced any further.
text_b: We were moving in a stop-and-go fashion on the incline. The young lady behind me misjudged the distance and slid into my rear bumper. She was very apologetic and cooperative, and we exchanged our documentation right there on the street.

text_a: The street is very narrow and I was making a delivery. I heard a scraping noise and realized I caught the Nissan's rear door. I accept full responsibility for not checking my blind spot carefully enough.
text_b: I was driving down the main street and the other driver pulled out of the parking space right in front of me. I slammed on the brakes, but couldn't avoid the collision given the slick road.

text_a: I was driving across the bridge when a sudden gust of wind—or perhaps just a loss of focus—caused the car in the lane next to me to drift into my path. It was a light collision, but the side of my vehicle now has a long, ugly scratch along the passenger door. I had to pull over at the first available safety zone to inspect the damage. I am very frustrated because I take great care of my car's paintwork, and this happened in such a chaotic environment.
text_b: I was driving behind both vehicles on the bridge. I clearly saw the vehicle in the right lane veer slightly to the left while trying to adjust his mirror, resulting in a side-swipe contact with the BMW. Both drivers handled the situation professionally by pulling over to the designated emergency area to check their vehicles for scratches.

text_a: I was driving home along Avenida Luísa Todi in the evening. The traffic was dense and a truck in the lane to my right started merging into my lane without signaling properly. I tried to steer left, but there wasn't enough room, so he side-swiped my door. There is a very clear dent in the center of the door and multiple scratches along the frame. It all happened so fast, and I am still shaking from the impact. I am just hoping the repairs are straightforward.
text_b: I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the truck drift into the lane of the Toyota. It appeared to be a simple error by the truck driver who likely didn't see the smaller car. The contact resulted in visible damage to the side of the Toyota, specifically a dent and some scratches. It was an unfortunate accident, definitely no malice involved.

text_a: Ugh, like, I was just trying to park near the market, you know? And this other car, a really old one, like, scraped my side as it passed. It was barely moving, maybe 10 km/h, but it totally messed up my car! I have a big dent, a massive scratch all down the side, and I'm pretty sure there's a crack on the panel too, dude. This is going to cost a fortune, I'm so stressed out!
text_b: I was walking by, just saw a very light contact between a Ford Fiesta trying to park and an old white van passing by. The van's mirror just brushed the Fiesta's side. I only saw a light scratch on the Fiesta, nothing more significant than that. It was a very minor incident.

text_a: I heard a crash and saw the Skoda hit the utility pole. The street was actually very quiet at that moment, and I definitely did not see any other car nearby, especially not a sports car of any color.
text_b: I was attempting to parallel park in a very tight spot near the Praça da Figueira this afternoon. I thought I had enough clearance, but as I was backing in, I misjudged the angle and scraped my rear wing against the white van parked behind me. I feel quite silly about it, honestly. There is just a long, deep scratch along my rear quarter panel. The other driver wasn't there, so I left a note with my contact information on their windshield.

text_a: Everything happened so quickly on the A23 under the rain. A dark blue estate car swerved abruptly into my lane near Abrantes, forcing me to clip the guardrail to avoid a massive collision. I definitely have a major dent on the side panel and a shattered window, though I'm shaken. Please, you must understand how aggressive they were driving before they fled the scene without stopping. I have the repair invoices ready for submission immediately.
text_b: I was parked at the rest area nearby. I saw the Seat Ibiza intentionally pull into the guardrail while the driver was alone. There was no other car involved, certainly no estate car near the scene. It looked completely staged.

text_a: I was at the intersection of Avenida da Liberdade and Rua do Salitre. I believed the light was green for me to make a left turn. As I proceeded, an Audi A3 entered the intersection at speed. We collided. My car has a very noticeable dent on the front passenger door, the passenger side window is completely shattered, and my front right headlamp is broken. I am certain I had the right of way.
text_b: I was walking down Avenida da Liberdade, near the Rossio. I saw a silver Seat Ibiza turn left onto Rua do Salitre. It looked like they failed to yield to a red Audi A3 coming from the opposite direction. There was a loud impact. The Seat Ibiza's front passenger side sustained a significant dent, the passenger window glass shattered, and its right headlamp was clearly broken. The Audi also had some front-end damage. It was quite a shock, really, everyone stopped to look.

text_a: While cruising at 100 km/h, a silver hatchback performed an illegal, aggressive cut-off, causing me to swerve into the concrete barrier. My side is shredded, and there is a huge dent on the door. The other driver sped off toward Lisbon. I need the police report filed immediately so I can claim for these damages. It is absurd that reckless drivers like that get away with destroying someone's property.
text_b: I was driving behind the Tesla. The driver simply veered into the wall. There were no other cars nearby. I didn't see any silver hatchback on the highway at that time.

text_a: Traffic on the main avenue was backed up due to construction. I was at a complete standstill when a delivery van behind me failed to stop in time. They hit me quite hard, pushing my car forward into the one ahead. It caused significant damage to my rear bumper, leaving a large dent and a long scratch. Also, the force of the impact caused some of the rear window glass to shatter. I am quite worried about the repair process since the car is very important to my daily commute.
text_b: I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM when the traffic suddenly stopped. It was raining quite heavily and I didn't judge the distance correctly at 30 km/h. I tapped the back of the car in front of me. I am really sorry about this, I feel so terrible because I know I wasn't paying enough attention. There is just a small dent on the rear bumper of their car, and I'm really worried about the insurance process. Do you think this will take a long time to get fixed?

text_a: I was attempting to parallel park in a very tight spot near Rua Augusta. There was a lot of noise and pedestrians walking around, which made it hard to concentrate. I thought I had enough clearance from the car behind me, but as I turned the wheel to pull in, I misjudged the distance and grazed my rear side panel against their front bumper. There is a visible scratch on the paintwork now. I am so embarrassed; I should have just asked someone to help me guide the car into the space.
text_b: I was sitting at a cafe table on the sidewalk nearby. I watched the driver of the white Fiat trying to park. It was a very tight squeeze and they were moving very slowly, but they eventually miscalculated the angle and hit the car parked behind them. I saw a scratch appear on the side of the Fiat. It was clearly an honest mistake during a parking maneuver.

text_a: At exactly 09:15, I was proceeding legally through the intersection when this BMW aggressively T-boned my passenger door. I maintained a steady speed of 30 km/h. It was a violent impact that spun my car 180 degrees. The other driver immediately admitted fault and suggested we fill out the forms. I am absolutely shaken by this calculated act.
text_b: My brakes completely failed as I approached the junction. I could not stop the vehicle. I slammed directly into the side of the Seat. There was nothing I could do to avoid this collision.

text_a: I take full responsibility for the collision. I looked away for a brief moment and did not see the car in front stopping for the light. I hit them at about 20 km/h. I immediately checked on the other driver, and we agreed to file the report through the insurance companies. My bumper is also damaged, but the main issue is the impact to their rear.
text_b: I was stopped at the red light when I felt a sudden impact from behind. It was not a heavy crash, but enough to feel the jolt. I got out and saw the driver of the Golf looking quite anxious. He admitted it was his fault immediately. There is a dent on the rear bumper of my car from the impact.

text_a: I was stationary in the queue waiting for the lights to change when I felt a hard jolt from behind. The impact pushed my car slightly forward. Upon exiting, I saw that the driver behind me was quite shaken and admitted he couldn't stop in time due to the slippery road conditions.
text_b: Dude, I was trying to get out of the parking lot, and this guy, like, in the Audi, he totally waved me in! He made eye contact and motioned for me to go! So I started moving, and then he just accelerated into me. My Fiat Panda has a dent and a scratch on the side. I don't understand, he waved me in, like, for real!

text_a: I was walking down Rua da Prata when I saw the driver attempting to maneuver past the delivery vehicle. The driver was going very slowly, but they misjudged the angle and made contact with a parked car. It was clearly a low-speed accident caused by the narrowness of the street and limited space.
text_b: I was trying to park in a very narrow spot in Coimbra city center yesterday afternoon. I misjudged the distance from the stone pillar on my left while reversing. I heard a scraping sound and stopped right away. When I got out, I realized I had scraped against the pillar, causing a dent and a deep scratch on my rear bumper. I feel so embarrassed about it, honestly. I've been driving for years and I should have been much more careful with such a tight maneuver, but the street was quite dark.

text_a: I was sitting at the cafe terrace right next to the parking spot. I saw the driver trying to maneuver into the space. It was a very tight spot and she was going slowly, but she miscalculated the angle and hit the other parked car. I saw the dent and the scratch appear on the bumper of the silver vehicle. She has been very polite and is waiting for the owner.
text_b: I was driving about twenty meters behind the two vehicles. I saw the Renault begin to move into the left lane without signaling clearly. The other driver couldn't react in time, and there was a clear contact between the two sides of the cars. It left a visible scratch on both vehicles, but thankfully they didn't collide hard enough to lose control.

text_a: I was proceeding through the intersection when the lights turned amber. I didn't want to slam on the brakes, so I proceeded, but the car coming from the cross street entered the junction prematurely. We collided at a very low speed. I was driving with my daughter in the back, and we were quite scared, but thankfully no one was hurt. My front bumper has a noticeable dent now. I am a very careful driver, so this is quite distressing for me to deal with today.
text_b: I was standing on the corner waiting to cross the street. I saw the Renault entering the intersection just as the light was changing. The other vehicle didn't wait for the light to fully turn green for them and pulled out into the junction. It was a low-speed impact, but clearly, there is a dent on the bumper of the Renault.

text_a: I was heading through the green light at the intersection. Another driver came from the side street, seemingly failing to notice the red light. I hit the brakes, but I still clipped their rear bumper. It was quite a shock, man, really unexpected. My front bumper took most of the force, leaving a large dent and a long, jagged scratch across the paint. I am just really glad that nobody was hurt, but I am super stressed about how long the car will be in the repair shop.
text_b: I was waiting to cross the street when I saw the silver Ford enter the intersection correctly. The other car definitely ran the red light and clipped the Ford. It happened in seconds. The Ford had a dent and scratches on the front bumper. I am happy to provide my contact details as a witness.

text_a: My grandson was helping me navigate to the doctor's office, and with all the construction work on the road, I got a bit distracted. The traffic light turned red and I did not notice it in time, causing me to hit the back of the car stationary in front of me. I am very upset because I have been driving for forty years without an accident. The impact caused a large dent in my front bumper. It is all quite embarrassing to be honest, but the other driver was very polite.
text_b: I was waiting at the red light when I felt a significant impact from the rear. When I stepped out to inspect, the elderly gentleman from the Renault was very apologetic. My rear bumper clearly has a dent from the force of the collision, but thankfully no one was hurt.

text_a: I was driving through the industrial zone when a heavy truck ran a stop sign and hit my front quarter panel, causing a significant crack. I believe he did it on purpose to intimidate me. The impact was violent. I have photos of my car showing the damage, but I need you to pursue him because he left the scene of the accident immediately after the hit.
text_b: I saw the Nissan waiting at the corner. As I passed, he pulled forward and drove his bumper into the side of my trailer. He wasn't hit; he hit me.

text_a: I had to brake suddenly because of a taxi. The Toyota behind me couldn't stop and hit my rear. There is a dent on my bumper and my tail light is broken. The driver of the Toyota was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the process.
text_b: I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the two vehicles collide during a lane change. The Toyota had its indicator on, but the vehicle in the adjacent lane seemed to accelerate just as the merge was happening. It appeared to be an honest misjudgment of speed and distance by both drivers.

text_a: I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was trailing a silver car, and when the driver ahead braked suddenly for a pedestrian crossing, I just couldn't stop in time. I was probably only doing 20 km/h, but I bumped into their rear bumper. It was completely my fault, I was a bit distracted by the radio. There is a noticeable dent on my front bumper now. I feel terrible about it, honestly, it was just a lapse in concentration on my part.
text_b: I was stopped at the crosswalk because someone was trying to cross the street. Suddenly, I felt a solid impact from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the Volkswagen behind me. He came out and apologized immediately, clearly upset. My rear bumper sustained a dent from the impact, but thankfully nobody was hurt in the incident.

text_a: Navigating the roundabout, a white van cut into my lane without warning. The friction was quite significant, resulting in a deep scratch, a smashed rear passenger door, and a shattered taillight assembly. This is absolutely unacceptable driving behavior in the city. The damage to the bodywork is extensive, and I expect the claim to cover the total replacement of the door panel and the entire lighting system. I have always been a careful driver, but this idiot has ruined my weekend plans.
text_b: I was walking near the roundabout when I saw the van brush against the Qashqai. It looked like a minor contact, mostly just paint transfer. I didn't see any major impact that would crush a door or break a light.

text_a: I was driving straight on Avenida 5 de Outubro. The Seat Ibiza turned directly in front of me. I had no time to brake. I did not wave the driver on. The impact caused a dent and scratches on the right front of the Ibiza. My van has no damage.
text_b: I was working at the café nearby. I saw the BMW accelerate quite hard on the straight road and lose traction before hitting the bollard. I did not see any other car nearby, certainly no white van in the vicinity at that time.

text_a: I was driving along the coast road when a silver motorcycle swerved into my lane, forcing me to hit the guardrail to avoid a collision. The motorcycle did not stop and just vanished into traffic. The damage to my left side is extensive, including a long scratch and a deep dent from the steel railing. I am certain they are responsible for my repairs.
text_b: I was sitting at the bus stop and watched the car drifting slowly toward the guardrail. There were no other vehicles anywhere near that Tesla for several hundred meters. The driver simply lost concentration and struck the barrier directly.

text_a: I witnessed the Hyundai attempting to navigate the narrow street. It did not leave enough room and scraped against the side of a parked car, causing a clearly visible scratch on the paintwork.
text_b: I saw everything. The driver of the Mercedes was driving perfectly, and the other vehicle surged out from the side street intentionally. It looked like they were waiting for him to get close before pulling out. I felt obligated to stop and report exactly what I observed.

text_a: It was pouring rain on the bridge. Visibility was quite low, and the traffic suddenly slowed down near the exit. I attempted to brake, but I think the road was a bit slippery. I made contact with the rear of the car ahead of me. The impact shattered my headlight and broke the lamp housing. I am an elderly driver, and this situation has really left me quite rattled. I have always been a careful driver, so this is quite distressing for me to deal with this afternoon.
text_b: I was driving in the lane next to the two vehicles involved. Due to the heavy rain, the traffic was moving slowly, but the driver of the Toyota clearly struggled to stop on time when the vehicle ahead braked. I saw the collision occur and pulled over to offer my details, as the impact caused the Toyota's lamp to break and the headlight glass to shatter on the road.

text_a: I had to stop abruptly to avoid a person walking across the street. The car behind me hit my rear end. My vehicle only has minor damage, but the other driver's lamp is broken and there is a dent on their Peugeot.
text_b: I work in the bakery right next to that parking space. I haven't seen any delivery trucks or vans hitting any cars this morning. The street has been relatively quiet.

text_a: I WAS TRYING TO PARK ON RUA AUGUSTA! THIS OLD LADY WAVED ME IN, THEN HIT ME! MY SIDE WINDOW IS SHATTERED, MY REAR LAMP IS COMPLETELY BROKEN, AND THERE IS A HUGE DENT AND SCRATCHES! SHE IS LYING! THIS IS CLEAR NEGLIGENCE! I EXPECT MY CAR TO BE FIXED TOMORROW! I AM CONTACTING MY LAWYER IMMEDIATELY IF YOU DRAG YOUR FEET ON THIS! THIS IS A COMPLETE SCAM!
text_b: Oh, it was terrible, bless my soul. I was just trying to help the young man, he seemed to be struggling with the parking space, you know. So I waved him forward, and then, oh my, he just grazed my bumper. My little Fiat Punto, it just got a tiny little scratch. And his car, well, it had a little dent, but nothing broken, certainly no glass, my dear. He got so angry, shouting and all, it was quite frightening. I just wanted to help, like I always do for my grandchildren.

text_a: Everything happened so quickly near the intersection. I was proceeding cautiously on the green light when the other car suddenly veered from the right, intentionally blocking my path. My bumper made direct contact with their side door. I am certain they did this to provoke a payout, as they barely moved their vehicle out of the way afterward, acting like they expected the collision exactly where it occurred.
text_b: The insured driver completely disregarded the traffic signal and accelerated into my lane, striking me with significant force. I had no time to maneuver. This was a clear act of negligence, and I expect full coverage for all the repairs needed for my vehicle.

text_a: The wind on the bridge was exceptionally strong today. I felt my trailer sway, and I believe I might have crossed the lane marking for a split second. I heard a scraping sound and pulled over immediately to check. I noticed a scratch on the Seat next to me. I apologize for the incident, the weather conditions were very difficult to manage at that moment.
text_b: I was riding in the left lane when the car suddenly swerved toward me. I moved to the edge of the lane to avoid a fall, and that's when the side of the car made contact with my handlebar, causing a scratch along the door panel. It was quite scary, to be honest.

text_a: I was proceeding along the right lane of Avenida dos Aliados. I signaled to move to the middle lane, not realizing there was a car already occupying the space. I only noticed when I heard the impact. My front indicator lamp is broken from the contact. I feel quite shaken by the incident, as I honestly did not see the other driver at all during the maneuver.
text_b: The driver of the Seat moved into my lane without sufficient space or warning. I tried to brake, but he still hit my side mirror. His indicator lamp was shattered during the brief impact, which occurred at a low speed of approximately 20 km/h.

text_a: We were both driving very slowly, almost to a stop. I was signaled by the Kia driver to move forward so he could drive his bumper into my wheel. He kept talking about his insurance company covering the repairs before the police arrived.
text_b: I was stopped at the yield sign entering the Marquês roundabout. The driver of the approaching Renault Megane made a distinct waving motion with his left hand, yielding right-of-way. I proceeded at 12 km/h. He then intentionally accelerated, causing a T-bone collision. My driver door has a deep dent, a long scratch, a structural crack, and the side indicator lamp is broken. I did not violate any laws.

text_a: I was slowly circling the roundabout when the other vehicle accelerated and slammed into my side door with deliberate force. My car was pushed across the lane markings perfectly. The way it happened feels like a setup, as I have dashcam footage that they requested I delete immediately. My door is dented, obviously, and I need a total repair.
text_b: The Mercedes was driving way too slowly and created a bottleneck. I tried to pass, and we collided. It was an accident, pure and simple, so quit asking questions and just pay the claim for the bumper damage.

text_a: I was sitting on the bench nearby and witnessed the lady reversing her Mini. She seemed very careful, but the pillar is poorly positioned. She hit it, and I heard the sound of the glass from the lamp breaking. It was clearly an accident and she seemed very upset when she got out to check the damage.
text_b: Driving along the Marginal in Cascais is usually lovely, but today was just hectic. A truck merged into my lane while I was right next to him. He didn't see me at all. His metal side rail scraped my door and managed to shatter the side mirror glass. I am incredibly frustrated by this incident because the car is brand new and I have always been a very careful driver. I need this to be resolved quickly, as I have an important business trip coming up soon.

text_a: I was exiting my parking spot with extreme caution, checking all mirrors. Out of nowhere, the car parked behind me accelerated forward at high speed and slammed into my reversing vehicle. It caused my entire rear lamp cluster to smash into pieces. It felt planned, almost as if they were waiting for me to engage reverse to jump into my path. They need to pay for the full repair and my subsequent rental costs; I refuse to pay a cent of the excess.
text_b: I was walking my dog nearby. The Peugeot driver reversed quite fast and hit the stationary car behind them. The car that was hit didn't even have its engine running at the time of the impact.

text_a: I was cruising along the coast when an old red sedan swerved into my lane, forcing me to strike the concrete retaining wall to avoid him. My windshield cracked upon impact, and the front bumper is badly dented. I tried to get his plate, but he just sped off into the tunnel. There was nobody else around to see it, but I hope the cameras in the tunnel caught him.
text_b: I was driving behind the Peugeot. I did not see any red sedan at all. The driver was going quite fast on the winding section of the road and appeared to lose control on his own. I stopped to check on him, but he immediately started asking me if I saw a red car.

text_a: Heading northbound across the bridge, a large, unmarked truck suddenly performed an illegal emergency stop in the middle lane. To avoid hitting them, I had to swerve, but a following vehicle clipped my rear end. The truck just kept driving as if nothing happened. The stress of this event is overwhelming. I am trying to recall the license plate, but it all happened so quickly in the heavy afternoon traffic. This entire incident was caused by that phantom vehicle's erratic and dangerous maneuvers.
text_b: I was driving behind the Audi and observed them brake suddenly for no apparent reason. There were no other vehicles ahead that could have necessitated such a violent stop. They claim there was a truck, but I honestly did not see anything of the sort.

text_a: I was pulling out of a parking spot near the shopping center. It was very crowded, and as I turned the wheel to exit, I didn't see the car passing by in the narrow lane. We hit each other at a very low speed. My front bumper now has a dent and a visible scratch from the metal trim of the other vehicle. I feel terrible about it; I really thought the path was clear, but clearly, I was wrong. I've already exchanged contact details with the other driver.
text_b: I was walking on the sidewalk nearby when I heard the collision. The Fiat 500 was moving slowly out of the parking spot, and the driver of the other vehicle didn't have enough time to stop. It was clearly an unfortunate accident due to the poor visibility in that spot.

text_a: I was driving behind the Toyota and had a clear view. The road was relatively empty. The driver seemed to lose control on their own and swerved into the barrier. I never saw any motorcycle, blue or otherwise, near the vehicle at that time.
text_b: I was walking by the square and heard a loud scraping sound. I looked over and saw the small car had hit the stone bollard on the corner. The driver looked quite upset. I could see the damage to their door, specifically a dent and a deep scratch from the stone. It looked like an honest accident.

text_a: I was walking my dog near the tram stop when I saw the van swerve sharply to miss a cyclist who had drifted into the lane. The Citroën couldn't move over because of the traffic in the left lane. It was clearly an accidental collision caused by the cyclist's sudden movement forcing the van's reaction.
text_b: I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio, planning to take the second exit toward the airport. I was in the inner lane when the car next to me tried to move across without checking their blind spot. I swerved slightly to avoid a full collision, but we still ended up scraping each other on the side. I am just really annoyed because I was heading to a meeting and now I have this scratch on my passenger door to deal with. It all happened so fast, honestly.

text_a: My wife and I were driving to pick up our grandkids for the weekend. The sun was quite bright, and when the traffic light turned amber, the car in front of me stopped extremely abruptly. I slammed on my brakes, but I still slid into their bumper. My headlight and the glass cover have suffered a major glass shatter. At my age, these things are quite stressful, especially with all the noise of the traffic on this busy road. I just want to make sure everything is handled correctly by the insurance company.
text_b: I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus when I saw the collision. The traffic light changed unexpectedly, causing the first car to stop very suddenly. The driver of the BMW tried to react, but the distance was too short, and he hit the car ahead. The impact definitely broke some glass on the front of the BMW.

text_a: While navigating the narrow streets of Cedofeita, I encountered a delivery van that had stopped suddenly. I applied the brakes, but my car slid slightly on the cobblestones and bumped into the van's rear. This resulted in a broken tail lamp and some light scratches on the trunk. It is a very tight area and visibility is poor, but I accept that I was moving too fast for the conditions. I am hoping for a quick repair, as I use this car daily to manage my small business deliveries around the city center.
text_b: It was a busy afternoon on the N125. The car in front of me braked hard for a turning vehicle, and although I tried to avoid contact, my front bumper tapped their rear. There is only a light surface scratch, but the driver is claiming I shattered his entire rear lighting array and caused whiplash requiring physiotherapy. It feels like he is trying to exploit the situation for a much higher payout.

text_a: I witnessed the Hyundai attempting to navigate the narrow street. It did not leave enough room and scraped against the side of a parked car, causing a clearly visible scratch on the paintwork.
text_b: I was waiting at the pedestrian crossing, observing the traffic flow at Rotunda do Relógio. A grey Seat Ibiza was attempting to exit the roundabout, signaling appropriately. A commercial van, white, subsequently entered the roundabout at what appeared to be an excessive speed, failing to yield. It impacted the right front side of the Ibiza. Damage included a dented fender and a broken headlamp on the Seat. The van continued without stopping. I estimate the van's speed at impact was around 45 km/h.

text_a: I was attempting to parallel park in a tight spot near the shopping center. I must have misjudged the distance to the vehicle behind me because I felt a slight jolt as I backed up. I stopped immediately and got out to check. It turns out I scraped the other car's bumper, causing a scratch and a small dent. I feel terrible about this mistake. The street was quite narrow and I was worried about holding up traffic, which probably made me rush the maneuver more than I should have.
text_b: I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the Fiat 500 attempting to park. The driver seemed to be struggling with the space. They reversed too far and made contact with the stationary car. I saw both a scratch and a dent on the rear bumper area.

text_a: The Renault stopped abruptly. I was distracted for just one second checking my side mirror. When I looked back, the gap had closed, and I bumped their rear. It was my fault.
text_b: I was driving on N125. The other car tried to change lanes without looking. I thought he was waiting. He just drove into me. Minor damage to my rear left side, a scratch. His fault entirely. I was going about 50 km/h. No, I did not wave him in. That is incorrect.

text_a: While navigating the heavy morning congestion, a dark gray delivery van suddenly swerved into my lane, forcing me against the guardrail. I braked hard, yet the van didn't stop and vanished into the traffic near the exit toward Alcantara. I am shaken. The entire side of my car is ruined with deep gouges, and I need this claim handled fast because I use this vehicle for my consulting business.
text_b: I was driving behind the BMW. There was no van involved. The driver simply veered into the side rail while distracted by a phone call. I saw no other vehicle change lanes in that section.

text_a: I saw the Ford lose control on the curve, but there was no truck in sight. It looked like they just misjudged the speed of the turn and hit the barrier themselves. I was watching the road specifically because they were wobbling for a few hundred meters.
text_b: I honestly thought the light would stay green longer. I was looking at my GPS for a split second, and when I looked back up, he had stopped. I couldn't stop in time. I am very sorry for the damage to your light and bumper.

text_a: I was heading toward Almada, and the traffic was moving at a slow pace. I tried to change into the right lane to exit the bridge, but there was a blind spot issue. My side mirror clipped the side mirror of a truck that was moving alongside me. It was a very loud noise, like glass shattering, and sure enough, my side mirror glass is completely shattered. I am quite worried about the repair costs because the part is electronic and probably expensive to replace.
text_b: I was maintaining my lane on the bridge when the car next to me suddenly moved over. They hit my mirror, which caused their mirror glass to shatter on impact. We stopped at the first available safety bay to check the damage.

text_a: I was maneuvering to get into a spot near the Praça do Comércio. I was moving at maybe 5 km/h, and I didn't see the low bollard in my rear-view camera because of the bright sunlight reflecting on the screen. I backed into it, which caused a scratch and some glass shatter from my rear light assembly. Man, this really ruins my day. I was just trying to get to my meeting on time, and now I have to deal with this mess.
text_b: I was standing near the square when I saw the small car reversing. The driver clearly didn't see the metal post behind him. He hit it quite softly, but the sound of the glass shattering was distinct. I walked over to ask if he was okay, and he seemed very stressed about the damage to his car. It was clearly just an unfortunate accident due to the poor visibility.

text_a: I was cruising near the Alameda when the other car suddenly braked hard for absolutely no reason in the middle of the empty lane. I had zero time to stop and smashed directly into his bumper. It was a violent impact, completely crushing my headlights and causing a massive dent. I have all the documentation ready and my neck is starting to hurt. You must settle this claim quickly as I need my car for work and cannot afford to wait around for weeks while you investigate these blatant facts.
text_b: I was driving at a normal speed when I saw a cat cross the road. Naturally, I braked to avoid hitting the animal. The Mercedes behind me was clearly traveling at an unsafe speed and failed to keep a proper distance, ramming into the rear of my car.

text_a: My wife and I were driving down the EN125 near Faro to visit our grandchildren. The weather was bright, but the sun was hitting the windshield at an awkward angle. While merging onto the main road, I didn't notice the pickup truck coming from my left side. We made contact, causing a long scratch and a shallow dent along my driver-side door. We are both over 70, so we were a bit shaken up, but thankfully it was only a low-speed side-swipe and no one was physically hurt in the process.
text_b: I was driving along the EN125 at about 50 km/h when the Toyota attempted to merge without seeing me. I tried to brake, but we still ended up swiping each other. My side of the truck is fine, but their car definitely has a dent and a scratch where we made contact. It was an unfortunate incident, but the elderly couple was very polite and cooperative throughout the whole insurance exchange.

text_a: It was raining heavily when I approached the intersection. As the traffic light shifted to yellow, I eased off the accelerator, but the car behind me failed to brake in time. It swerved into my side panel before I could fully stop. My door is deeply pushed in and there are long scratches running across the metal. I am really shaken up by how fast it happened, and honestly, I have no idea how much these repairs will cost at the garage.
text_b: The visibility was extremely poor due to the downpour. I misjudged the distance between our vehicles while trying to maintain momentum before the red light. I slid on the wet asphalt and my bumper connected with the passenger side door of the Seat. It was entirely my fault.

text_a: A black sports car forced me off the road into a metal post. The impact shattered my windshield and scratched the whole side of my SUV. The other vehicle didn't even slow down; it just continued toward Lisbon. It all happened so fast, I couldn't get a clear look at their license plate.
text_b: Wait, I am not a third party driver. I was driving my own car on the other side of the road and saw the Volvo hit the pole. There were no other cars nearby. The driver of the Volvo just drifted off the road on their own.

text_a: I was pulling into a parking space at a shopping center in Albufeira. It was extremely busy with tourists, and as I was trying to maneuver into the spot, I misjudged the proximity to the car parked next to me. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had scratched the side of the other car. I am so worried about the costs, but I waited by the other car until the owner returned so we could exchange information properly.
text_b: I returned to my car after shopping to find the driver of the Fiat waiting for me. She explained that she had accidentally scratched my door while parking. She was very honest and we exchanged all the necessary insurance details on the spot. It was an unfortunate but clear-cut accident in a tight parking spot.

text_a: I was slowing down for the pedestrian crossing and the car behind me didn't stop in time, hitting my rear bumper. I got out to see if everyone was okay. The other driver's front lamp was broken and there was a dent on their bumper. We agreed to exchange insurance information and file the report immediately.
text_b: I was distracted checking an address for a delivery on Avenida 24 de Julho. I didn't realize I was moving out of my lane until I heard the contact. It resulted in a scratch on the side of the BMW. I take full responsibility for the error in judgment.

text_a: I stopped because I saw a dog on the road, which is basic safety. The Volvo driver was clearly following way too closely and didn't have enough time to react. I heard a small tap, but my car is mostly fine.
text_b: I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM. The traffic on Avenida da Boavista was extremely heavy as usual. I was keeping a safe distance, but the car in front of me braked quite abruptly due to a cyclist crossing the road. I tried my best to hit the brakes, but I still rolled into the back of the car. It was really stressful, and I felt terrible about the damage. My car has a noticeable dent on the front bumper now, and I am quite worried about the repair costs for both vehicles.

text_a: While navigating the heavy morning fog near the roundabout, a mysterious dark van suddenly swerved into my lane without signaling. To avoid a catastrophic head-on smash, I was forced to steer hard into the metal guardrail on the right. The van sped away without stopping, leaving me stranded. The side of my car sustained a long scratch from the rail. I am honestly shaken by how quickly the other driver just vanished into the morning mist without a single glance back.
text_b: I was walking my dog nearby and heard the screech of tires. When I looked, I only saw the BMW pressed against the guardrail. There was absolutely no other car in sight, definitely not a van.

text_a: The traffic flow on the bridge bridge suddenly stopped. The car in front hit their brakes aggressively, and I followed suit, but the driver behind me slammed into my rear. It felt like a perfectly orchestrated trap. My vehicle suffered a dent, yet the guy behind me jumped out before I even put the car in park, claiming he already had a witness who saw the whole thing happen.
text_b: I was driving behind both vehicles. The driver in the Yaris was completely stationary when the car behind it accelerated unnecessarily and rammed them from behind. It was a clear-cut case of reckless driving. I stopped specifically to make sure the Yaris driver had my contact info for their insurance claim.

text_a: My driving was impeccable. I was proceeding through the Rotunda do Relógio, adhering strictly to the right-of-way protocol, at a speed of 25 km/h. Suddenly, the third-party vehicle executed an unexpected maneuver, cutting directly into my path. I applied maximum brake pressure; however, an impact was unavoidable. My front right bumper sustained a significant dent, numerous scratches, the right headlamp is broken, and there's a large crack on my windshield near the passenger side.
text_b: I was stopped at the traffic light just off Rotunda do Relógio, facing east. I saw a silver Citroën C3 cut sharply in front of a blue Ford Focus. There was a small 'thump'. The C3 had a dent on its front corner, and the Focus had a scrape on its back. Didn't see any broken lights or windshield cracks on the Citroën.

text_a: At approximately 10:15 on 2026-03-16, while navigating Rua da Prata at a reduced speed of 10 km/h, a pedestrian abruptly entered the crosswalk without observing traffic signals. Despite immediate brake application, my vehicle, a BMW 320d, made contact with the individual's leg. The pedestrian reported no injuries and declined medical assistance. Visual inspection of my vehicle's front bumper revealed a minor dent and associated paint scratches. Police were not called as all parties confirmed no injury or further incident.
text_b: I was having my morning coffee at the café on Rua da Prata. I saw a man just walk into the road without looking. The black BMW was going really slow, but it just touched him. The man seemed fine, he just dusted himself off. The car had a little dent, like from a knee or something, on its bumper. Everyone was calm.

text_a: I was parking near the plaza, trying to squeeze into a tight spot. I misjudged the distance to the bollard and ended up tapping it slightly. The force was enough to cause the passenger side glass to shatter into the interior. I feel silly for making such a mistake in this busy area.
text_b: I watched the driver trying to park for a few minutes. They were going very slowly, but they just clipped the edge of the stone pillar. It wasn't a violent collision, but it was enough to break their window immediately upon contact.

text_a: A white sports car suddenly veered into my lane, forcing me into the guardrail at high speed. There was a loud bang, and my windshield cracked while the side panels were deeply scratched. The other vehicle didn't even slow down; it just vanished into traffic. I'm reporting this as a hit-and-run involving a phantom driver. I need a full replacement of the glass and structural bodywork, as the impact was severe enough that I think the battery housing might have been hit too.
text_b: I was driving behind the Tesla. There was no white sports car anywhere near us. The driver just drifted into the guardrail on their own while looking down at their phone.

text_a: I was parking near the shopping district and misjudged the distance to the post, resulting in a small dent to my bumper. I am quite embarrassed by this clumsy mistake. I have been driving for over thirty years without a single scratch, and now this happens on a Tuesday morning. The dent is about five centimeters wide. I assume the bumper assembly will need professional bodywork. Given the high costs in central Porto, I anticipate this will be a somewhat expensive repair, but safety is definitely my primary concern right now.
text_b: I watched the whole thing from the cafe window. The driver tapped the concrete post at very low speed. It was a tiny dent, certainly not enough to warrant the talk of structural frame damage the owner is mentioning on the phone right now.

text_a: At approximately 14:00, while operating a Ford Focus at a speed of 15 km/h near Praça do Comércio, a pedestrian unexpectedly stepped into the roadway from between parked vehicles. Despite immediate braking, contact was made. The impact caused a dent to the front hood, a crack in the bumper, and the right-side headlight glass shattered. The pedestrian sustained minor abrasions but refused medical assistance. Police report (CBR-2026-009-RP) filed.
text_b: I was attempting to merge into the middle lane because my lane was ending soon. I didn't check my blind spot properly and bumped into the side of the BMW. I take full responsibility for the scratch on their door, it was completely my error.

text_a: The delivery truck driver opened his door while I was passing by, hitting my mirror and the side of my car. Now the entire side panel is ruined and there is structural damage that will require a full repaint and part replacement. I’ve been told the car isn't safe to drive until the suspension check is complete, as the impact was quite significant. This will certainly cost me a fortune to repair if the insurance doesn't cover everything properly.
text_b: I barely cracked my door open. The Skoda was driving much too close to the parked row of vans. It left a tiny scratch on their mirror, which I offered to buff out myself. They are definitely making a scene over nothing.

text_a: I was working in the shop that was hit. I didn't see any motorcycle or any other vehicle on the road before the Mercedes crashed into my store window. The driver appeared to be moving too fast and simply lost control of the steering wheel on their own.
text_b: I looked down at my phone for just a split second to check the GPS, and when I looked up, the traffic had already stopped. I tried to brake, but I wasn't quick enough. I hit the Mercedes in front of me.

text_a: I had parked my car near the campus while I went to pick up my daughter. When I came back, there was a note on my windshield saying someone had bumped into me. The rear bumper has a large dent and the tail lamp is broken. I feel so frustrated, man, it's just really unfair that someone can hit your car and you aren't even there to prevent it. I don't know who did it, but the damage is pretty obvious, and it’s going to be a real pain to get it repaired this month.
text_b: I saw the Nissan driving correctly in its lane. The other car pulled out from a side road without yielding, forcing the Nissan to swerve and leading to the scratch on the side of the car. It was clearly the merging driver's fault.

text_a: I parked my car and walked to the cafe. When I returned, the side was covered in long, deep scratches. Clearly, someone hit me while parking. The entire door panel is warped now because of the pressure. I expect the insurance to cover a full repaint and panel replacement for the whole left side of the vehicle.
text_b: I watched the other car park next to yours. They touched, but it was just a tiny graze to the plastic molding. There is definitely no damage to the door panel itself, and the bodywork is perfectly straight.

text_a: I was stopped in traffic when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The other driver hit my vehicle at a low speed because they were unable to stop fast enough. There is some minor damage to my rear bumper, specifically a dent and some scratches, but thankfully everyone is physically fine.
text_b: I was making a slow turn at an intersection. I barely scraped the Peugeot. It was a very light touch, no more than 5 km/h. I saw a minor scratch, nothing else. The driver of the Peugeot is making a big fuss over nothing, in my opinion.

text_a: I came to a stop because I noticed a cyclist swerving in the lane. The driver behind me didn't seem to see me braking in time. He hit my rear bumper. My car is relatively undamaged, but I was worried about the driver behind me because he looked quite distressed. We exchanged information immediately, and he seemed very concerned about the damage to his headlights.
text_b: I was walking nearby. I saw the Volvo strike the wall, but I never saw any motorcycle or any other traffic that would have caused such an abrupt swerve.

text_a: I was waiting in the queue when I felt a jolt from behind. The other driver hit my bumper at a low speed. My car is fine, but their front lamp is broken. We exchanged information immediately.
text_b: I was hiking on the path overlooking the road. The driver just drifted into the barrier while going around the bend. There were no other cars on the road at all, let alone a black SUV.

text_a: I was walking my dog on the pathway nearby. I saw the Audi hit the barrier, but there was absolutely no other car in sight. The driver was alone and hit the concrete while checking their phone.
text_b: I parked the car near the supermarket entrance around 10:00 AM. When I returned twenty minutes later, I noticed a fresh dent on the rear wheel arch. A lady was waiting by my car with a note; she apologized for hitting me while trying to reverse her own vehicle. She was very cooperative and we filled out the accident declaration form together.

text_a: While cruising at 80 km/h on the IC19 towards Sintra, a large white delivery truck cut me off without signaling. I slammed on the brakes, swerved sharply to the left to avoid a catastrophe, and brushed against the metal crash barrier. My car sustained a dent on the passenger side panel. The truck did not even bother to stop or acknowledge the dangerous situation it created. I am absolutely furious about the lack of road safety on this highway during the morning rush hour.
text_b: I was driving behind the Yaris for several kilometers. The road was relatively clear, and I saw the driver lose control of the vehicle suddenly and hit the barrier. There were no other vehicles in the immediate vicinity at that time, especially no delivery trucks.

text_a: I entered the intersection on a yellow light, thinking I had enough time, but a car coming from the perpendicular road started moving before their light was fully green. We collided at a low speed. My front door has a large dent, and the window glass shattered from the impact. I am feeling quite shaken, to be honest. It all happened so fast, and the noise of the glass breaking was really loud and terrifying. I'm just grateful that neither of us was hurt during this whole unfortunate event.
text_b: I was waiting at the pedestrian crossing when I saw the Audi get hit. The other car definitely accelerated when they should have stopped. It was a clear collision. I saw the side mirror glass shatter and the metal dent upon impact. I stayed behind to ensure both drivers were okay and to offer myself as a witness for the insurance claim process.

text_a: I saw the silver car scrape the metal barrier while taking the corner way too fast. There were absolutely no other vehicles nearby, especially not any trucks. The road was nearly empty at that hour.
text_b: While I was driving home, a dark blue van swerved into my lane suddenly, forcing me to brake hard. I hit a post while trying to avoid the van, but the van didn't stop and just drove away toward the highway. My front bumper is badly dented from the impact with the stone pillar. Why would someone just drive off like that after causing such a mess?

text_a: Back in my day, people were much more careful in parking lots! I was doing my weekly grocery shopping at the center here in Funchal. When I returned to my Citroën, I noticed a fresh scratch along the rear quarter panel. I suspect someone scraped it while reversing out of the adjacent spot. It is very disheartening to find your vehicle damaged like that when you weren't even present. I am reporting it so I can get it polished out by a professional, as I take great pride in keeping my car clean and tidy.
text_b: I was walking to my own car nearby when I saw a delivery truck trying to exit the spot next to this Citroën. The driver of the truck misjudged the turn and I heard the sound of metal scraping. The truck driver didn't stop, but I saw the scratch left on the Citroën.

text_a: A dark sedan threw a large stone or debris from their tires that smashed my windshield into a web of cracks. They didn't even notice, or they just didn't care to stop. It was a heavy impact. I need the windshield replaced immediately under the glass coverage as the visibility is now dangerously compromised for me.
text_b: I was riding my motorcycle behind the Fiesta for a while. There was nobody in front of him. I saw the crack form after he hit a pothole, but there were no other cars nearby to throw any debris.

text_a: It was late at night, around 11:30 PM, and I was driving home along the riverfront. The street lights were dim, and I was trying to merge into the right lane. I didn't see the van in my blind spot until it was too late. I clipped their side, and my headlamp shattered against their frame. I am really sorry, man, I just didn't check the mirror properly. There is a scratch on my bumper and my front lamp is broken.
text_b: I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the Toyota try to merge into the right lane. The driver didn't seem to notice the van already there. It was a clear case of a failed blind-spot check. I saw the lamp break and heard the scraping sound of the vehicles colliding.

text_a: While navigating the heavy traffic on the VCI, a dark grey van abruptly swerved into my lane, causing me to swerve into the concrete barrier. The van did not stop and fled toward the Arrábida Bridge. My car has sustained a massive hole in the passenger side door and a completely shattered windshield because of this aggressive maneuver.
text_b: I was standing on the pedestrian overpass observing the traffic flow. I saw the Toyota hit the barrier, but there was absolutely no other vehicle in that lane at the time. The road was relatively clear.

text_a: Traffic was crawling along at about 20 km/h. The vehicle ahead of me braked suddenly to avoid a scooter that cut them off. I hit my brakes hard, but the road was a bit slick, and I slid forward just enough to hit their rear bumper. It resulted in a visible dent on my front bumper. I am really stressed out about this because I am late for an important meeting, and now I have to wait for the police report to be finalized.
text_b: I was waiting at the bus stop nearby and saw the whole thing. A scooter darted in front of the line of cars, causing a chain reaction. The Mini driver didn't have much time to stop and bumped the car in front. I saw a dent on the Mini's bumper.

text_a: A black SUV with tinted windows drifted into my lane without checking blind spots. To avoid the crash, I steered hard toward the guardrail. I grazed the metal and my front bumper is now scratched and dented. The SUV sped off, and because it was so early, there were no witnesses to capture the plate. I expect the insurance to cover the bodywork and professional repainting.
text_b: I was jogging along the promenade nearby. I heard the tires screech, but the Audi was the only vehicle on the road. The driver just drifted too close to the rail while looking at a phone. There was absolutely no other car in that lane.

text_a: Driving south at 80 km/h, a white commercial van suddenly cut into my lane without signaling. I had to swerve hard towards the concrete barrier to avoid a collision. The van sped off immediately, but the side of my car hit the barrier guard, causing a deep scratch down the length of the passenger side. I tried to get the license plate, but it was too dusty. I need this processed urgently as I rely on this car for my daily work visits.
text_b: I was nowhere near the Eixo Norte-Sul at that time of day. I have been in a depot in Almada all morning. This claim mentions my van, but I have not been on that road in over a week.

text_a: I was on the A1. The car in front just stopped dead for no reason. I hit him. It wasn't my fault, he just stopped. My SUV has a huge dent, scratches, a crack on the grille, and the headlamp has a glass shatter. I don't care about the details, just process the claim. Send the money to my IBAN.
text_b: I was driving normally. A dog ran out, so I had to brake hard. The BMW hit me from behind. I think we can just settle this quickly with the insurance, no need for police. My car has a dent.

text_a: I was driving home from work near the Rotunda da Boavista, moving at maybe 20 km/h in slow traffic. Suddenly, the car ahead of me stopped abruptly for a cyclist, and I just couldn't brake in time. It was a stupid mistake, really. I hit the back of his bumper, and now there's this noticeable dent right in the middle of my front bumper. I feel terrible about it because the other driver was quite calm, but I'm worried about how much this is going to cost to repair on my insurance policy.
text_b: I was slowing down normally because of the traffic flow when I felt a sudden impact from behind. The driver behind me didn't seem to notice the traffic had come to a full stop. It wasn't a hard hit, just enough to leave a small dent on my rear bumper. We pulled over immediately to exchange details.

text_a: It was getting dark, around 7:30 PM, when I reached the junction. I had the right of way, but another vehicle crossed my path while attempting an illegal U-turn. My car hit them on the side. I have a dent, a broken lamp, and multiple scratches on my front end. I am quite shaken up by the whole ordeal. I have never been in an accident before, and I am not entirely sure what the next steps are for filing the report correctly.
text_b: I saw the entire thing from the sidewalk. The driver of the Citroën was driving at a normal speed and clearly had the green light. The other driver tried to make a U-turn where it is clearly prohibited, which caused the Citroën to strike them. It was a genuine accident caused by the other driver's poor decision at the intersection.

text_a: I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música when another driver attempted to exit from the inner lane while I was still proceeding forward in the outer lane. I tried to steer away, but there was no space. The contact happened right against my passenger side. It’s my first accident and I'm really worried about the repair costs, you know? The front passenger lamp is broken and there is a long scratch running along the side panel. It happened so fast, I didn't even have time to honk.
text_b: I was in the inner lane of the roundabout and perhaps miscalculated the exit. I turned towards the exit and did not realize the Seat was still there. I am sorry for the trouble caused; I accept full responsibility for the collision. My car also sustained some damage in the process.

text_a: I was attempting to merge onto the Ponte 25 de Abril from the Almada side. The driver of the Fiat Panda in the adjacent lane clearly indicated for me to proceed, gesturing me forward. Trusting their signal, I initiated the merge. Without warning, they then accelerated, impacting my front passenger side. The collision caused my front headlight to shatter completely, a significant dent to the fender, and the passenger side window is cracked extensively. This was a clear case of deceptive signalling.
text_b: I was travelling on the access ramp to Ponte 25 de Abril. I observed the Hyundai i30 attempting to merge. I made a hand gesture, intending to communicate 'wait', but it appears the other driver misinterpreted this as an invitation to merge. They proceeded, and contact was unavoidable. My front bumper sustained a deep dent, and my driver's side headlamp is now inoperable. The Hyundai's passenger window also appeared to crack from the impact.

text_a: I was driving along the coast road, the sea was beautiful today. I moved to the right lane to prepare for my exit, and a delivery truck was also merging at the same time. We both didn't see each other and his side mirror made contact with my rear quarter panel. It left a nasty scratch, but thankfully no dent. I've been driving for years and honestly, it was just one of those bad moments where timing was off.
text_b: I was merging onto the lane and I admit I might have moved over too fast. The road was busy and I was checking my mirrors, but the Mercedes was already there. It was just a minor contact, just enough to leave a scratch on their paintwork.

text_a: While parking my car near the University, I was struck by a driver who was reversing blindly. It was quite chaotic. After the impact, I noticed a huge scratch down the passenger side and my rear left lamp is completely shattered. I really need the insurance to cover the full bodywork and light replacement immediately, otherwise I cannot get to work tomorrow. This needs to be prioritized.
text_b: I was pulling out of my parking spot when I clipped the rear panel of the Toyota. It was a very minor contact, just a light surface scratch, certainly not enough to break a tail lamp. He is definitely overreacting to the situation.

text_a: While driving on the main avenue, the vehicle in the adjacent lane drifted into mine. I had nowhere to go because of the concrete median on my left, so our side mirrors and doors scraped against each other. There is a long scratch along my passenger side now. I maintained a steady speed of 40 km/h, but the other driver was clearly not paying attention to the lane markings. It's frustrating because I had just washed the car this morning, and now this happens.
text_b: I was checking my navigation system and drifted slightly to the right without realizing it. By the time I corrected, the side of my car had already grazed the Hyundai. I am fully responsible for this lane departure error.

text_a: I was navigating the roundabout near the Casa da Música, trying to exit towards Avenida da Boavista. The traffic was quite heavy as it was around 6:00 PM. I was in the middle lane when the driver in the outer lane suddenly cut across to exit early, and I couldn't avoid contact. There is a noticeable dent on my front passenger door and a long scratch along the side panel. Honestly, I'm just so stressed about this whole ordeal, I really didn't expect this to happen while just heading home after work, you know?
text_b: I misjudged the distance while trying to exit the roundabout. I didn't see the other car in my blind spot until it was too late. I accept full responsibility for the collision. My car made contact with the side of their vehicle while I was merging into the exit lane.

text_a: I was already in the middle of the junction when the Mercedes accelerated towards me. I think he saw me and decided to hit me on purpose. The damage to his lamp is very light, nothing like what he is claiming.
text_b: I was stopped in the line of traffic. The car behind me didn't stop in time and nudged my rear. It is just a minor scratch on my bumper. No major problems to report, and we handled the paperwork right there.

text_a: Navigating the Marquês de Pombal roundabout is always intense with so many lanes. I was in the middle lane when the bus on my right moved left unexpectedly. I tried to avoid it, but there was nowhere to go. We made contact, which left a dent and a long scratch along my side. I am just glad it wasn't a more serious accident, but the bodywork damage is definitely visible. I have already contacted my insurer to get the repair estimate underway.
text_b: I was pulling away from the bus stop area and preparing to shift lanes within the roundabout. I didn't see the Nissan in my side mirror until it was too late. I clipped the side of his vehicle, resulting in a scratch and a dent on his passenger door. I've reported the incident to my company and have provided my details to the driver of the SUV.

text_a: I was pulling out of a private driveway onto the main street. I checked the traffic, but I failed to see a cyclist passing by on the side. I moved forward just a bit too far and the side of my car hit their bike handle. The contact caused the glass shatter on my side mirror housing. I feel absolutely awful about the accident. I should have double-checked my blind spot again. I immediately stopped to check on the rider, who thankfully seemed okay aside from being very shaken.
text_b: I was riding my bike along the street when the car pulled out from a driveway without stopping properly. The car hit my handlebars. The impact was loud enough that I heard the car's side mirror glass shatter. I am lucky I didn't fall off.

text_a: While driving along the coastline, an unmarked grey van forced me off the road into a gravel verge. A loose stone kicked up by their tire cracked my windshield immediately. They never stopped, continuing toward Estoril at a very high speed. I had to pay for a tow truck myself because the vibration was making the crack spread across the entire field of vision. It was a terrifying experience and I hope the local cameras caught that aggressive van.
text_b: I was riding my bike nearby. There was no van at all. The driver just drifted off the road onto the gravel and kicked up the stone themselves when they tried to pull back onto the asphalt too fast. There were no other vehicles on this stretch of road for the last five minutes.

text_a: I was driving slowly along the Avenida dos Aliados. A heavy delivery truck was pulling out from a side street and its rear tail gate swung out wider than I anticipated. The metal corner of the truck struck my driver-side mirror, causing the glass to shatter completely. It was quite loud and really startled me. I wasn't going fast, maybe 20 km/h, but the proximity to the truck made it impossible for me to avoid the collision once I saw it moving.
text_b: I was performing a delivery and pulling out of the side street. I didn't realize how much the back of the truck would swing out in this narrow space. I heard the glass shatter and stopped immediately. I take full responsibility for the accident.

text_a: Traffic was crawling on the bridge when a white van ahead of me braked hard. I stopped, but the car behind me didn't. Then the van just took off and exited the bridge, ignoring the mess they caused. My bumper has a large dent. It is frustrating that I cannot provide a license plate for the van because they moved so fast to escape the congestion.
text_b: I only saw the Nissan brake suddenly for no reason. There was no van in front of him. I tried to stop, but the road was narrow and I couldn't swerve in time.

text_a: I saw a delivery driver reverse slowly and hit the bumper of the Polo. The tail lamp broke, but the window remained completely intact. The driver is exaggerating about the glass being shattered.
text_b: I was sitting at the nearby cafe and saw a delivery van trying to park in the space behind this Nissan. The driver miscalculated the distance and scraped the side of the parked car. He got out, looked at the damage, then just left without leaving a note. I saw the whole thing.

text_a: I was navigating a very narrow street in downtown Porto. A cyclist swerved in front of me, and in my attempt to avoid him, I clipped a parked delivery van. It was quite a shock. The impact caused the side mirror of the van to hit my passenger window, causing the glass to shatter. It was a very confusing situation with the cyclist, the narrow road, and the parked van. I have taken photos of the broken glass to ensure the insurance report is accurate for the claim process.
text_b: I was walking on the sidewalk nearby. I saw the driver of the SUV swerve to avoid a cyclist who cut them off. The SUV clipped the parked van, and I saw the passenger side glass shatter immediately. It was an unfortunate sequence of events that happened very quickly.

text_a: I was parking my car near the park in Setúbal. I was trying to maneuver into a rather tight spot, and I thought I had plenty of clearance from the parked car next to me. Unfortunately, I underestimated the angle of my turn, and the rear corner of my bumper scraped along the front door of the other vehicle, causing a deep scratch and a dent in his door panel. It was entirely my fault; I was just trying to get to my doctor's appointment on time and didn't check my proximity sensors carefully enough.
text_b: I was inside a café when I heard a scraping sound outside. I went out to see this gentleman hitting my car while he was parking. There is a clear dent and a long scratch on the passenger side door. We have exchanged all the necessary insurance details now.

text_a: I was driving north on the main avenue. I checked my mirrors, signaled, and began changing into the left lane to prepare for a turn. I suppose there was a blind spot, because as I moved, I felt contact with another vehicle that was also merging. We stopped right there. There is a noticeable scratch on the side of my front bumper. I am quite worried about the repair costs, so I hope the insurance procedure is straightforward.
text_b: I was in the lane next to the BMW. When they started merging, I thought they had seen me, but then the vehicles touched. It was a minor collision. My side panel received a light scratch, and the other driver's front bumper has a corresponding scratch.

text_a: I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio, trying to head towards the airport, and honestly, the roundabout was super chaotic. I was in the outer lane when a van suddenly cut across me to exit, and I just didn't have enough room to react properly. It was such a stressful moment, man, like, one minute I'm driving fine and the next I feel the side of my Fiat scrape against his rear panel. I've got a long, deep scratch along my passenger door now, and I'm honestly just really worried about how much this is going to cost.
text_b: I was exiting the roundabout and checked my mirrors, but I suppose I didn't see the smaller car in the adjacent lane. It was a simple misjudgment on my part while navigating the heavy traffic near the airport. We pulled over immediately to exchange details. There is a small scratch on my rear bumper and his passenger side door.

text_a: Traffic on the bridge was backed up, as it often is during the morning commute. I was at a complete standstill when a car behind me failed to stop. The impact was quite strong; it pushed my car forward a meter. The rear glass is shattered into pieces and the bumper has a massive dent. I am incredibly anxious because this is my only car for work. I have never had an accident before, so I'm not really sure what documents I need to provide to the insurance agency right now.
text_b: I was looking down for a second to adjust the air conditioning and when I looked up, the traffic had stopped. I couldn't stop in time on the bridge deck. I hit the Fiat from behind. The impact definitely damaged the rear end of their car, including the window glass. I accept full responsibility for this incident. It was entirely my lapse in concentration while driving in the queue.

text_a: It was foggy near the bridge in Gaia. A heavy commercial truck merged without checking mirrors and shoved me into the concrete partition. My car is totaled; there is a massive dent and structural failure. The truck driver just kept driving, completely ignoring the carnage they caused. I have recorded the incident in my memory, and I expect the insurance company to track down that license plate through traffic cameras right away.
text_b: I was walking my dog by the bridge. There were no trucks on the road at that hour. The Mercedes driver simply lost traction on the slick pavement and hit the barrier themselves.

text_a: I was parking near the cafe, the street is extremely narrow and the cobblestones were quite slippery from the rain. As I reversed, I misjudged the distance to the post and clipped the parked van next to me. I hit the rear tail light and the bumper. I left a note on the windshield before calling my insurance agent.
text_b: I returned to my van to find a note from the driver of the Citroën. The tail light is smashed and there is a dent on my bumper panel. I appreciate that they were honest enough to leave their contact details after the accident.

text_a: I was moving through the lane when the Fiat suddenly pulled out in front of me. I slammed on the brakes, but we still caught each other's side. The impact caused a dent and scratch to the side of the Fiat. I think both of us were just having a moment of confusion with the flow of traffic.
text_b: I am not very familiar with these roads and I was looking for the turn-off. I wasn't looking at the car ahead as much as I should have been. When I looked back, the Nissan was braking and I just couldn't stop in time. I hit the back of his bumper, causing a dent. I am very sorry for the trouble.

text_a: I was crossing the bridge heading toward Almada. The traffic had come to a sudden, complete standstill, which happens often there during peak hours. I braked in time, but the driver behind me was clearly not paying attention. They struck the rear of my Volvo quite hard. My rear bumper is severely dented, and the impact caused the glass in my rear tail light to shatter completely. I am just glad no one was injured, but it is such a hassle dealing with the paperwork and getting the car to the repair center.
text_b: I was driving two cars behind the incident. I saw the traffic stop abruptly. The driver in the Volvo stopped safely, but the small hatchback behind them didn't brake until the very last second. It was a clear rear-end collision on the bridge. I pulled over to ensure everyone was okay before continuing my commute.

text_a: Last night near the industrial park, a white commercial truck with no license plate visible forced me off the road into a concrete post. My headlight is completely shattered and the mounting bracket is destroyed. The other driver never even hesitated; they just sped off into the darkness toward the highway. I had to pay for a tow truck myself because the police were busy with another call. You absolutely must cover the total replacement of the lamp assembly and the bumper sensor suite.
text_b: I was driving home from my daughter's house in Braga. It was raining quite hard and the visibility was not great, to be honest. I was approaching the roundabout when the traffic ahead slowed down drastically. I applied the brakes, but the road surface was slippery and my car slid forward, hitting the rear of the vehicle in front of me. I caused a significant dent on their trunk and my own lamp is broken. I feel absolutely dreadful about it, especially since the roads were so dangerous today. I just wish I had maintained a much safer distance.

text_a: I was stopped in heavy traffic when I felt a moderate jolt from behind. I checked my rearview mirror and realized the driver behind me hadn't stopped in time. When I got out, I saw that the impact had caused a dent and some deep scratches to my rear bumper cover. We exchanged details calmly.
text_b: I heard a crash and saw the Skoda hit the utility pole. The street was actually very quiet at that moment, and I definitely did not see any other car nearby, especially not a sports car of any color.

text_a: I was sitting in my car finishing a coffee when I felt a jolt. The driver of the Fiat 500 was trying to park and hit the side of my vehicle. I got out and inspected the area; there is definitely a deep scratch along my rear door panel. The driver was very apologetic and admitted they didn't see me parked there. We exchanged information immediately.
