text_b: I saw the Megane swerve on its own while trying to adjust lanes. There were no other vehicles within ten meters of that car when the incident occurred.

text_a: I was trying to park my Fiat in a very tight spot on Rua da Prata this morning. I thought I had enough clearance while turning the steering wheel, but the angle was sharper than I estimated. I ended up scraping the rear quarter panel against a concrete pillar in the parking garage. There is a deep scratch there now. It is incredibly frustrating because the space was quite narrow and I was being careful, but I clearly misjudged the proximity to the wall.
text_b: I was walking by the parking area when I saw the driver attempting to maneuver the Fiat into the narrow spot. They were going very slowly, but the car made a scraping sound against the pillar. I saw the driver get out immediately to check the damage, which looked like a visible scratch on the side of their car. It was clearly an honest mistake while trying to park.

text_a: Stop-and-go traffic made me slow down quickly. The car behind hit me with enough force to propel my vehicle forward by two meters. My neck started aching instantly, and now I notice the entire bumper is crushed and the rear suspension feels loose, probably destroyed by the impact. I require a full diagnostic and a rental vehicle for the next two weeks while they replace every component in the back of my car.
text_b: It was a tiny bump at a dead stop. Her car didn't even move an inch. There is a small dent on the license plate frame, but she is demanding a full repair of the suspension which is ridiculous.

text_a: Traffic was moving at 80 km/h when the car in front of me slammed on their brakes without any visible cause, forcing me to strike them. My front lamp was destroyed and the bonnet is completely buckled. The other driver immediately claimed their engine failed, which is suspicious because they were accelerating just before the brake lights went on.
text_b: The Peugeot was aggressively following me for miles. I eventually had to stop due to an object on the road. The impact was planned by him; he kept signaling me to pull over aggressively even before we touched. He is clearly at fault for following too closely.

text_a: Everything happened so fast at 2 PM. A delivery van swerved in front of me, forcing me to stop instantly, and the car behind hit me at speed. It was absolutely not my fault. There is a huge dent in my trunk and I demand an immediate resolution. I saw several pedestrians watching, surely they can testify that the van was the one driving recklessly. I've taken photos and documented everything; my insurance should cover the full repair cost immediately without any further delay or investigation.
text_b: I was walking nearby and heard a noise. I did not see any delivery van. The cars just seemed to have hit each other suddenly without any prior swerving or erratic movement from other vehicles.

text_a: I was driving carefully on the coastal road when a black sports car drifted into my lane on a blind curve. I had to swerve hard to avoid a head-on collision and ended up hitting a stone wall. The black car just drove away without stopping. My front lamp is broken, and there is a deep dent in my hood. I am honestly traumatized by the experience and demand that the insurance company tracks down the footage from nearby businesses to identify that phantom driver.
text_b: I was walking my dog nearby and watched the Jeep driver lose focus and hit the wall while trying to navigate the curve. I was looking at the road, and there were no other cars anywhere near that turn for several minutes.

text_a: Driving toward the river, a dark blue commercial truck drifted into my lane without signaling. To avoid a head-on collision, I jerked the steering wheel right, hitting the barrier. The truck didn't even stop; it just sped off toward Cais do Sodré. I have these significant dents and long scratches on my side panels that need urgent assessment for insurance coverage.
text_b: While navigating the narrow streets of Cedofeita, I encountered a delivery van that had stopped suddenly. I applied the brakes, but my car slid slightly on the cobblestones and bumped into the van's rear. This resulted in a broken tail lamp and some light scratches on the trunk. It is a very tight area and visibility is poor, but I accept that I was moving too fast for the conditions. I am hoping for a quick repair, as I use this car daily to manage my small business deliveries around the city center.

text_a: I was backing out of my space when I just barely touched the bumper of the car behind me. There is a very tiny crack on their plastic trim. I am worried because the driver is claiming I shattered their entire assembly and caused damage to the frame, which is just not possible given how slow I was moving.
text_b: The impact was severe and resulted in a huge crack in my bumper, along with damage to my sensor array and internal mounts. This car needs a full replacement of the entire rear housing. I expect full coverage for this since the other driver was clearly not looking at what they were doing.

text_a: I was waiting at the yield sign, perfectly still, when the Golf accelerated quickly toward me and steered right into my fender. It felt like they wanted to ensure we had contact right in the middle of the junction.
text_b: I live in the house facing the road. I heard a loud screeching and saw the Golf sliding into the barrier alone. No other cars were on the road at that hour. The driver got out, looked at his car, and started making a phone call.

text_a: I was in the vehicle behind the Mercedes. The driver lost control while moving between lanes and hit the side barrier. I saw absolutely no other vehicles nearby that would have caused such an aggressive maneuver.
text_b: At approximately 14:35, while navigating Avenida dos Aliados, my vehicle, a Peugeot 208, was involved in a side-swipe incident. I was executing a lane change to the right, having activated the turn signal for the statutory duration. The third-party vehicle, a Mercedes-Benz C-Class, attempted to overtake in a restricted zone. The contact resulted in a significant scratch along my passenger-side door and a broken rear-right lamp.

text_a: The traffic light turned red at the intersection, and I had to stop abruptly. The driver behind me didn't notice the change in time and struck my rear end. The impact caused a significant dent to my trunk and unfortunately, my right tail lamp is broken. I am stressed because I rely on this car to pick up my grandchildren from school every day. The other driver was very cooperative and we were able to clear the lane quickly so we didn't block the tram lines.
text_b: I looked down at my GPS for a split second to check the route. By the time I looked back up, the traffic had stopped. I tried to brake, but I couldn't avoid hitting the car in front. I damaged their tail lamp and rear bumper.

text_a: I was driving around the roundabout near the city garden. Another driver entered the roundabout too fast and hit my side window. There is a crack in the glass and shards of glass shatter on the upholstery. I am shaken up, dude, like my hands are still shaking while I type this. I didn't expect that to happen at all. I just want to make sure my insurance covers this so I can get back to work tomorrow without any issues.
text_b: I entered the roundabout, but I miscalculated the distance of the Volvo approaching from my right. It was a lapse in judgment on my part. I hit their passenger side, causing their window to shatter. I immediately stopped to provide my information. The driver of the Volvo was understandably upset, but we managed to exchange details calmly once the police arrived to assist with the traffic flow.

text_a: As I was turning onto the main avenue, a large black SUV clipped my bumper and side panel, causing me to spin slightly. The driver didn't even look back, just sped away down toward the river. I have deep scratches and a dented door. It's frustrating that cameras in this city never seem to capture the actual plates of these reckless drivers during these incidents.
text_b: I was having a coffee on the terrace and saw the Audi driver try to park. He scraped the concrete pillar while backing in, turning the steering wheel far too early. There was nobody else on the street at the time, certainly no mysterious SUV fleeing the scene.

text_a: I was attempting a left turn from the Rotunda do Relógio, proceeding into the designated lane. The driver of the opposing vehicle, a yellow taxi, clearly signaled me to proceed with a hand gesture. Interpreting this as an invitation, I commenced my maneuver. Unexpectedly, the taxi then accelerated, resulting in a side-impact collision to my vehicle's front passenger side. I sustained a dent and significant scratches, and I firmly believe my passenger window has a substantial glass shatter and my front right lamp is broken. I acted entirely on the other driver's explicit instruction.
text_b: Eu não waved! I never waved him in! I was going straight, and he just cut in front of me from the roundabout. What is he talking about? There's a small dent and scratch on my taxi, but it's not from me waving. He's making this up.

text_a: Everything happened so fast at the intersection. I entered the green light when the other vehicle accelerated deliberately into my side panel. I had my dashcam off, which is unfortunate, but the impact force was massive enough to shatter the glass and frame. I really expect full coverage for this wreck because he clearly steered directly at me.
text_b: I was proceeding normally when the insured driver swerved into my path unexpectedly. It felt like they wanted the contact to happen. I tried to brake, but there was zero reaction time left.

text_a: Parking near the historical center is a nightmare. As I was pulling out slowly from the curb, a delivery van grazed my driver-side door. I’ve noticed a large shattered glass panel on my sunroof and a complete collapse of my side mirror assembly that wasn't there before. The insurance company needs to cover the full body restoration since this vehicle is my pride and joy, and the impact felt really severe to my neck.
text_b: I admit I was at fault. I was distracted for a split second by my GPS and moved into the left lane without properly confirming the lane was clear. I scraped against the side of the Peugeot. We both pulled over safely to the side of the road to inspect the damage.

text_a: I was circling the roundabout, staying in the middle lane. Another car was in the inside lane and suddenly decided to take the exit, cutting across my path. I tried to swerve, but I hit the curb, and he caught my rear bumper. There is a noticeable dent on the bumper and the rear lamp is broken. I am really annoyed, dude. I was driving perfectly well, and then this happens right in the middle of the city. I just hope the insurance covers the repairs without me having to pay a fortune.
text_b: I parked my car on the side of Avenida da Liberdade to run a quick errand. When I returned about twenty minutes later, I noticed a fresh dent and a series of scratches on my front left fender. It seems someone scraped against my vehicle while attempting to pull out of the parking space ahead of me. It is quite frustrating, as I take great care of my car. I hope the CCTV in the area might have caught something so I can verify who did this.

text_a: I was parallel parking and misjudged the distance, lightly brushing the parked car behind me. It was barely a touch, just a small scratch really. The owner appeared immediately and is now insisting that the chassis is misaligned and the entire bumper needs replacing. They are acting quite aggressive about it, shouting that the car is brand new and demanding an immediate, significant cash payout.
text_b: I WAS DRIVING ON THE A1 NEAR LISBOA, SOMEONE SWERVED INTO MY LANE AND HIT ME! THEY DIDN'T EVEN STOP, THE COWARD! MY CAR, A PEUGEOT 308, HAS A HUGE DENT ON THE SIDE, THE WINDOW IS COMPLETELY SHATTERED, AND MY HEADLIGHT IS SMASHED! THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE! I WANT THIS CLAIM PROCESSED IMMEDIATELY OR I'M CALLING MY LAWYER AND GOING STRAIGHT TO THE LIVRO DE RECLAMAÇÕES! DON'T WASTE MY TIME ASKING STUPID QUESTIONS!

text_a: It was a beautiful sunny afternoon and I was enjoying the view along the coast. I was cruising at about 40 km/h when the vehicle in front of me slowed down to turn into a beach parking lot. I didn't notice their turn signal until it was too late. I applied the brakes, but I still made contact. There is a distinct dent on the center of my front bumper. I feel so foolish for being distracted by the ocean view instead of paying attention to the road.
text_b: I was slowing down to enter the parking lot near the beach. I used my blinker well in advance, but the driver behind me didn't seem to notice. They bumped into my rear at low speed. We pulled over and verified the dent on their bumper.

text_a: Entering the intersection at green, I was T-boned by a vehicle coming from the side street at high speed. The physics make no sense unless he completely ignored the red light. My front passenger door is ruined and the light is shattered. I need to be compensated for the loss of use of my car during the busy work week, as this was clearly a targeted attack.
text_b: I watched the whole thing from the pedestrian crossing. Both drivers seem to have accelerated toward the impact point instead of trying to avoid each other. It looked almost as if they both wanted the collision to happen.

text_a: I watched the Fiat reverse and hit the metal post. It only made a slight scraping sound. I walked over later, and honestly, it looks like a simple surface mark that would buff right out.
text_b: I was walking on the sidewalk nearby and saw the two cars try to occupy the same space while exiting the roundabout. It was a slow-speed collision, but the impact was enough to break the light on the BMW and leave a long mark on the side.

text_a: I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música when another driver attempted to merge aggressively into my lane. I swerved slightly to avoid a full impact, but our mirrors clipped, resulting in a deep scrape along the rear panel of my passenger side. Honestly, I'm quite shaken up by how fast he was moving through the intersection. My hands are still shaking while I fill out these forms, and I am worried about the cost of professional bodywork in this city. It all happened within seconds during the afternoon rush.
text_b: The other driver didn't check their blind spot before shifting lanes while circling the roundabout. I was already holding my position in the outer lane when I felt the contact against my front wing. There is a clear dent where we met.

text_a: I was driving down Rua de Santa Catarina when the delivery van in front of me stopped suddenly to unload goods. I was distracted for a split second by my radio and couldn't stop in time. I hit them, which caused a deep dent and broke one of their tail lights, resulting in glass shatter on the road. I feel terrible about this mistake. It was such a silly moment of lost focus, and now I have to deal with the damage to both our vehicles.
text_b: I stopped briefly to check an address. The Ford behind me didn't seem to notice until it was too late. The impact was quite loud. My bumper is dented and the rear light housing has experienced glass shatter. He apologized immediately.

text_a: I was sitting at the cafe terrace right by the intersection. The Nissan was definitely moving on a green light, and the silver car rushed through the intersection after the light had already turned red. The contact was unavoidable, and I saw the dent and scratches appear on the Nissan immediately after.
text_b: There was no other car on the road. The driver just drifted into the signs while looking down at his phone. I was right behind him, and the road was completely empty for at least a kilometer.

text_a: I was looking over my shoulder to check the traffic before backing out of my parking spot. Unfortunately, I didn't see the car coming down the aisle because of a large delivery truck blocking my visibility. I backed right into the side of their car. It broke their rear lamp and put a nasty dent in the panel. I feel terrible about it. The other driver was very understanding, but it is clearly my fault. I have contacted my insurer immediately to start the necessary reports.
text_b: I was driving through the parking lane when the Peugeot backed out suddenly. They obviously didn't see me due to the parked van. My lamp is smashed and there is a dent on the passenger side.

text_a: An aggressive white sports car swerved into my path near the metro station, forcing me to veer right. To avoid hitting them, I collided with a stone planter and a street light. My lamp is broken and the glass of the mirror has a large crack. The phantom car didn't even slow down; they just vanished into traffic. It is impossible to catch them in this city traffic.
text_b: I was just checking my delivery notes and started moving forward because I thought the intersection was clear. It was a simple misjudgment of distance by a few seconds, not anything intentional as the driver claims.

text_a: Well, I was just going to the market, like I do every Thursday, you see. Driving my trusty old Citroën C3 around that big roundabout, the Rotunda das Portas da Cidade, you know? And this young man, he just came out of nowhere from the left, I think he didn't see me. Boom! Right into my side. Now I have a big dent and the headlight is broken, and a long scratch. My back was hurting a bit after, oh and the weather was lovely that day, not a cloud in sight, quite rare for November.
text_b: At the stated location and time, while entering the Rotunda das Portas da Cidade, I failed to yield to Vehicle 1, a Citroën C3, which was already circulating within the roundabout. My Mercedes A-Class impacted Vehicle 1's passenger side. Observed damage on Vehicle 1 includes a side panel dent, a broken headlamp, and superficial paint scratches. I accept responsibility for the collision.

text_a: While navigating the narrow section of Estrada Monumental near the hotel zone in Funchal, a delivery van, identified as a Ford Transit, encroached into my lane. This resulted in a side-swipe incident, causing a scratch and a dent to the left side of my vehicle. The incident occurred at approximately 30 km/h.
text_b: Oh man, like, I was just trying to get around that bend, you know? And that Audi, like, it was really close to the curb, so I misjudged it, pá. Just a small scrape, I think. My boss is going to kill me. Is his car, like, really damaged? Mine's okay, just a little scratch.

text_a: Traffic was dense during the afternoon rush. A car two spots ahead braked, causing a chain reaction. I stopped in time, but the person behind me pushed me into the car in front. The impact was light, just a small dent on the rear bumper, but now the driver is claiming he has chronic whiplash and needs a rental car for a month.
text_b: This person slammed into me with significant velocity, forcing me into the vehicle ahead. I felt a sharp pain in my neck and back immediately. My car has structural frame damage, and I am unable to drive it safely until a full evaluation is completed. My insurance company needs to handle this as a total loss.

text_a: Driving across the bridge, a large, unidentified black sedan cut me off without signaling, leaving a long scratch along my passenger side. The car didn't stop and sped away toward Almada. It was so fast I couldn't get the license plate, but there was definitely another vehicle that forced me into the divider. It's frustrating to pay for these repairs when it was clearly someone else's reckless driving that caused this mess.
text_b: I was two cars back during the incident on the bridge. The traffic was flowing normally. The Citroën swerved abruptly into the side barrier on its own; there was no black sedan or any other car involved in that maneuver.

text_a: I was checking my navigation system for a moment when the traffic in front of me halted unexpectedly. I could not brake in time and hit the vehicle ahead. The force of the impact resulted in a dent on my hood and a broken lamp on the right side. It was a very stressful situation, and I am quite upset with myself for being distracted. I have been driving for over twenty years and I know better than to look at my phone, but here we are.
text_b: I was waiting to cross the street near the plaza when I saw the BMW hit the car in front of it. It looked like the driver of the BMW was looking down just before the impact occurred. The collision wasn't at a high speed, but it definitely damaged the front of his car, specifically the light and the bumper area.

text_a: Traffic was slow along the avenue because of the bridge works. I came to a full stop, but the gentleman behind me was clearly distracted and didn't stop in time. He rear-ended my vehicle, which resulted in a nasty dent in the boot lid. I am quite shaken, man. It's just an awful situation to be in when you're just trying to get home after a long day. I've already taken photos of the damage and have the other driver's details ready for the claim report.
text_b: I witnessed the rear-end collision while walking along the promenade. The Opel was completely stopped for several seconds before the following car hit it at a low speed. It was clearly the fault of the trailing driver, who seemed distracted. I saw the dent on the back of the Opel immediately after they stepped out of their vehicles.

text_a: While cruising along the coastline, the car in front performed a dangerous brake-check, causing me to rear-end them. The collision left a dent and deep scratch on my hood, but more importantly, the impact was so severe it triggered all my cabin airbags and caused permanent spinal discomfort. My vehicle is essentially a total loss now, and I will be requiring significant long-term therapy and a full replacement value settlement. This was an unprovoked attack on my safety, and I expect full compensation.
text_b: I stopped because a pedestrian was crossing. He was going way too fast behind me. It was a minor bump; his airbags didn't even deploy during the contact. He is clearly lying about the severity of the damage and his physical condition.

text_a: Traffic was flowing at 70 km/h. Suddenly, the driver ahead locked his brakes for no discernible reason. I had no room to avoid him. My front lamp shattered against his tow bar. He was suspiciously ready with a printed claim form before I had even unbuckled my seatbelt. I am certain this was an intentional entrapment to solicit an insurance payout.
text_b: I braked because I thought I saw a dog on the road, okay? He was tailgating me way too closely. It is his responsibility to keep a safe distance regardless of why I stopped. Pay up.

text_a: I was sitting at a nearby cafe terrace and saw the car hit the barrier while taking the corner too fast. There was absolutely no other car on the road at the time. The driver just drifted into the guardrail on their own.
text_b: I was standing near the hotel entrance watching the road. The Mini driver was looking at his phone and veered directly into the concrete pillar. There was absolutely no motorcycle or any other vehicle on the road at that moment.

text_a: I was sitting at the outdoor cafe right in front of the car. I saw a white van trying to reverse into the spot behind the Audi. He turned the wheel too early and I heard a distinct scraping sound against the metal. The driver of the van got out, looked at the damage, then just got back in his vehicle and drove away before the owner returned.
text_b: I was checking my mirrors to pull out from the side of the road. I thought I had space, but the Citroen driver was moving faster than I anticipated. We made contact, resulting in some scratches and a dent on his passenger door. It was an unfortunate case of misjudged speed.

text_a: I was driving home from the office around 6 PM, just trying to get through the city center. A car in the adjacent lane began to merge without signaling. I tried to accelerate to avoid contact but there wasn't enough room. The side of my car sustained a long, deep scratch. It is so annoying, man, because I just got the car cleaned yesterday. I really hope the insurance can handle this quickly so I can get it painted.
text_b: I was standing on the sidewalk waiting for the pedestrian crossing light. I saw the silver Ford trying to move ahead, and the other vehicle drifted into their lane without looking. It wasn't a high-speed collision, just a side scrape. The Ford definitely had a scratch along the passenger door after the contact.

text_a: I was maintaining my speed in the right lane, and the driver of the Seat suddenly moved into my space. There wasn't enough time for me to avoid the collision. It caused damage to my front bumper and their side light.
text_b: I was driving behind the Golf for five kilometers. I saw the driver swerve into the guardrail, but there were no other cars nearby. The road was entirely empty, which makes me wonder why he turned the wheel so suddenly.

text_a: I was attempting to navigate through the narrow streets of Cedofeita to find a parking space. While turning a corner, I miscalculated the swing of my back wheel and lightly brushed against a parked car. I checked the damage and found a thin scratch along the side of their door. I am truly sorry for the inconvenience, as I know how hard it is to maintain a car in such a busy city with these tight parking spots.
text_b: I saw the driver maneuvering the small Volkswagen around the corner. They turned too sharply and the rear of their car rubbed against a parked silver sedan. I observed a long scratch on the paint afterward.

text_a: Heavy rain was hitting the bridge while a silver SUV forced me into the guardrail. I barely managed to hold the steering wheel straight. They did not stop after the contact and just vanished into the traffic flow. The entire right side of my vehicle is completely smashed in from the high-speed impact.
text_b: I was driving a few cars behind. The Seat Leon suddenly swerved toward the barrier, but there was no other vehicle anywhere near them. It appeared as if the driver lost focus on their own.

text_a: I was attempting to reverse into a parking space near the center of Coimbra. It was a very tight spot and there were many pedestrians walking by, which made me nervous. As I was turning the wheel, I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar nearby. I heard a loud scraping sound. When I got out, I saw a dent and a large scratch on my rear wing. It was completely my fault, and I feel so stupid for not checking my distance sensors more carefully while parking today.
text_b: I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the Fiat backing up. The driver seemed to be struggling with the tight angle of the parking spot. I saw the rear of the car hit the concrete pillar quite firmly. The driver got out immediately looking very distressed and inspected the damage, which clearly included a fresh scratch and a dent on the rear body panel.

text_a: It was raining, which made the cobblestones very slippery. As I approached the intersection, I saw the light turn yellow, but before I could safely stop, another driver entered the junction from the side. We collided at the corner. My car’s front window glass shattered and there is a noticeable dent on the hood. I am quite shaken up by this, as I was only trying to get to a doctor’s appointment. It is just one of those bad days, I suppose, and everything is quite overwhelming.
text_b: I was sitting at the outdoor cafe nearby. The Mini Cooper was driving too fast for the narrow street and just grazed the wall while taking the corner. The road was completely empty of other traffic at that moment.

text_a: At approximately 10:15 on Avenida da Boavista, I was maintaining a speed of 55 km/h, well within the limit. A black Dacia Sandero abruptly swerved into my lane from the right, directly in front of my vehicle, and immediately applied full brakes without any apparent reason. I had insufficient distance to react, resulting in a rear-end collision. My front bumper suffered a dent and scratches, and my left headlight is definitely broken from the impact. I confirm I was not under the influence of alcohol or distracted. This was an unprovoked incident.
text_b: I was cruising along the coast road, enjoying the ocean view, when the car in front of me slammed on their brakes for absolutely no reason at all. There was no traffic, no pedestrian, and no obstruction. I slammed my brakes, but I still slid forward and hit his bumper, creating a significant dent. I feel like this was completely intentional. Why would someone stop dead in the middle of a flowing road? It feels like they were waiting for someone to hit them.

text_a: I was the driver in the middle of this three-car pileup. The Volvo seemed to accelerate into the vehicle in front of it before I even hit them. I was barely moving, yet they slammed their brakes on as if expecting a collision to occur at that specific second.
text_b: The passenger asked me to stop, and although it wasn't a designated stop, I pulled over. I felt a light bump from behind. I checked my rear bumper and there is minimal damage, but I acknowledge the driver behind me didn't have enough time to react to my sudden stop.

text_a: It was pouring rain near Faro when a massive white refrigerated truck swerved into my lane at 110 km/h, forcing me into the emergency shoulder. The trailer side-slammed my vehicle, ripping through the body panels and causing severe structural trauma. The driver fled the scene immediately toward Spain. I am shaken by this reckless hit-and-run and hope your investigation captures their plate through the toll records.
text_b: I was driving behind the Golf for five kilometers. I saw the driver lose control on the slick tarmac and hit the guardrail, but there was no truck anywhere in sight.

text_a: I was stopped at the red light heading towards the bridge. The car behind me didn't notice I had stopped and bumped into me from behind. It wasn't a hard hit, just enough to leave a small dent on my trunk. I’m just a bit stressed about the insurance paperwork, as I’ve never done this before. I have a long day of errands ahead, and this is really setting me back. I'm just hoping we can get this sorted out quickly today.
text_b: I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus when I saw the car roll forward and tap the back of the Dacia. It seemed like the driver behind was looking at their phone and didn't see the traffic had stopped. It was a very low-speed impact.

text_a: I saw the Volvo hit the lamp post, but I did not see any other car nearby. The road was quite clear for a Tuesday morning, so there was no sports car around.
text_b: I was attempting to pass the VW Golf on Avenida da Boavista. The Golf unexpectedly drifted slightly into my lane. There was a minor contact. I believe the damage is superficial; a dent and a scratch on the Golf's passenger side door, consistent with a light scrape. My vehicle has a small scratch on the driver's side mirror casing. No 'lamp broken' or 'crack' on windshield observed on the Golf at the scene.

text_a: The gentleman behind me was unable to stop in time due to the rain. He hit my bumper at a low speed. My car is fortunately undamaged, but he clearly damaged his own hood and front panel. It was an honest mistake given the terrible road conditions today.
text_b: I was just driving, I never waved anyone out! This Ford just pulled right in front of me from a side street. I tried to brake but couldn't avoid a minor contact. It's just a small scrape on their car.

text_a: While driving in the center lane of the IC19 heading towards Sintra, a dark blue estate vehicle drifted into my lane without checking mirrors. I was forced to swerve hard to the right to avoid a head-on collision, clipping the concrete barrier. The other car never stopped and vanished into the dense morning fog. I am lucky to be alive after such reckless driving.
text_b: I was inside a nearby shop when I heard a thump outside. I walked out and found this Audi driver apologizing for hitting my parked van. It is just a minor surface scratch on the passenger side panel. I do not see any other damage.

text_a: I was walking down the Avenida for fifteen minutes. The driver hit the curb while distracted by his phone. There was absolutely no other car involved, certainly no red sports car.
text_b: I was walking past the parking area when I saw the driver attempting to maneuver into the parking bay. They were moving slowly, but they miscalculated the angle and the side of the vehicle made contact with the pillar. The driver stopped immediately, got out, and began inspecting the damage to their own vehicle.

text_a: I was passing the car when a sudden gust of wind pushed me toward the vehicle. I clipped the mirror and lost some balance but managed to stay upright. I stopped immediately to assist the driver. My handlebar hit their door, causing the damage we discussed.
text_b: I was driving home from work along the avenue. I signaled to switch to the right lane to prepare for my turn. I checked my mirrors, but there was a blind spot and I didn't see the motorcycle until it was too late. I moved over and we collided at low speed. The impact left a dent on my door panel and some scratches from the handlebars. I feel terrible about the motorcyclist, even though they were fine. It was just a simple, unfortunate mistake during a busy commute.

text_a: At exactly 14:30, I was proceeding through the green light at the junction. Suddenly, a blue car came out of nowhere and slammed into my driver-side door. I have been extremely careful to follow all traffic laws today. I believe the other driver was clearly distracted by his mobile phone and ignored the red signal entirely. I expect this claim to be processed with maximum priority to cover my extensive vehicle losses.
text_b: I witnessed the Toyota enter the intersection and get T-boned by the blue car. It was quite a shock. The Toyota driver was definitely not at fault as they had a clear green light and were driving perfectly within the lane markings.

text_a: It was pouring rain this morning. Traffic near the Baixa district was crawling, and when I looked down at my GPS for a split second, the Fiat in front stopped abruptly. I slammed the brakes but couldn't avoid the collision. My bumper is quite crushed, and I feel absolutely terrible about it.
text_b: I was cycling slowly through the gap when I brushed the Audi. There was nothing more than a superficial scuff. The light was perfectly fine when I left the scene. They are definitely making up the broken glass part.

text_a: There was a reckless motorbike weaving between lanes. He scraped my side mirror and caused a deep scratch on the door. He vanished into the traffic before I could see his license plate. I tried to follow, but it was useless. I'm worried about the repair costs because my insurance excess is quite high. I was keeping to my lane the entire time, doing 50 km/h near the center.
text_b: I was riding my bicycle in the lane next to him. There was absolutely no motorbike. The driver drifted into the curb while looking at his phone and scratched his own car against the wall.

text_a: I was driving northbound on the Avenida da República in the middle lane. I needed to move to the right lane to prepare for a turn. I signaled and checked my mirrors, but there was a blind spot issue with the SUV next to me. As I began to merge, we made contact. It caused a dent and some deep scratches on my front fender. It was a very brief moment of confusion. I am strictly following the formal reporting procedure as per your requirements for this type of collision.
text_b: I was driving in the right lane when the Mercedes attempted to merge. I didn't see his signal in time to adjust my speed. We made contact, resulting in a dent on my door and some paint damage on his fender. It was clearly a mutual misunderstanding of lane positioning in the heavy traffic flow.

text_a: I was waiting at the traffic lights when I saw the silver Mercedes get sideswiped. The driver in the other lane just swerved without looking properly. It wasn't a fast impact, but it was certainly enough to leave a nasty scratch on the door of the Mercedes. Both drivers looked quite annoyed, which is understandable given the traffic in Lisbon at this time of day.
text_b: I was standing on the sidewalk waiting for the bus when I saw the two cars collide. The driver in the left lane clearly drifted into the right lane without looking. It resulted in a clear scratch and dent on the Toyota's side. It happened quite fast.

text_a: Everything happened so fast at 10:30 AM. I was proceeding through the intersection when this white car suddenly accelerated from a side road to intercept my path. It was impossible to avoid the contact. The front of my car is completely demolished, and I am certain my chassis is bent beyond repair. I have photos of the heavy wreckage, which clearly shows my entire engine block being pushed backward by the force of the collision.
text_b: I watched the two vehicles carefully positioning themselves for about five minutes before the incident. They barely touched each other at low speed, and then both drivers got out to argue about which angle would look better for the claim report.

text_a: While signaling to change lanes, a white van accelerated rapidly to block me. He forced me into the median barrier, causing severe structural damage to my chassis and shattering my windows. It was clearly an attempt to cause an accident. I have my dashcam, but unfortunately, the SD card appears to have been corrupted exactly at the time of the incident.
text_b: I was just cruising in the middle lane at 40 km/h. This driver suddenly tried to squeeze into a gap that did not exist. I didn't accelerate; I actually braked to avoid him, but he still grazed his side against my fender. There was no 'forcing' involved.

text_a: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal, intending to take the third exit towards Avenida da Liberdade. The traffic was merging aggressively, and I misjudged the distance of the silver van in the outer lane. As I moved over, we scraped past each other. It was honestly just a small mistake on my part, and I feel terrible about it. There is a visible scratch along my passenger side door panel. I was moving at roughly 15 km/h during the maneuver. The other driver stopped immediately, and we exchanged details in a professional and calm manner.
text_b: I was maintaining my lane in the roundabout when the Seat suddenly moved into my space. I tried to brake, but there was no time to avoid the contact. It resulted in a scratch on my side trim, but thankfully no one was hurt. We both pulled over safely to the side to inspect the vehicles.

text_a: The traffic was dense on the IC19. The lead car came to a complete stop instantly. I couldn't avoid it and hit them. The impact was so violent that it broke my headlights, even though I was moving at a crawling pace. This is clearly a case of 'brake-checking,' a malicious act intended to cause this accident. My car is now suffering from severe electrical failure due to this contact, and I require total compensation for my medical bills and vehicle restoration.
text_b: It was a busy afternoon in Porto, and the streets were, as always, quite congested with tourists and delivery vans. I was proceeding slowly through a narrow section of the street when a parked van opened its door without checking. I swerved to the left to avoid the door, but I ended up scraping the side of my car against a concrete planter on the sidewalk. It left a very visible scratch along the entire passenger side. I am just glad no one was walking there at that time.

text_a: I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, you know, trying to stay in my lane. It was super confusing with all the construction work going on there today. Suddenly, I felt a scrape on the side of my car. I think I might have been drifting slightly while trying to merge, man, I'm really stressed because I just got this car. There is a deep scratch along the passenger door panel now, it looks pretty bad but at least nobody was hurt.
text_b: I was already established in the middle lane of the roundabout when the other driver tried to move into my space too quickly. I honked but it was too late to avoid the contact. My door suffered a superficial scratch from the side of their vehicle as they scraped past me.

text_a: I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was really heavy as usual. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing the road. I tried to press the brakes firmly, but I just couldn't stop in time. I ended up hitting his rear bumper at a very low speed. My front hood has a visible dent and some noticeable scratch marks now. I am quite worried about the repair costs, but I accept full responsibility for the accident.
text_b: I was looking for a parking spot and maybe rolled back an inch while on the hill. The guy behind me was already honking before I even moved. When I touched his bumper, he was out of his car instantly, claiming he had expensive electronic repairs needed for his headlight.

text_a: I was waiting for the bus across the street and watched the Volvo driver come around the bend far too fast. He just drifted wide and hit the barrier himself. There was definitely no other car on the road at that moment to blame.
text_b: I was standing on the pedestrian walkway near the bridge entrance. I saw the Volvo suddenly swerve into the guardrail, but I am absolutely certain there were no other vehicles in the vicinity at that time. The road was quite empty.

text_a: I was slowly pulling out of a parking bay onto the main street when a delivery van suddenly cut in front of me. I had to brake hard, and while I didn't hit them, the impact of the sudden stop caused a small crack in my front windscreen, probably from a flying stone that hit at the same moment. It’s just a small crack, but it’s right in the line of sight. I’m quite stressed about this because I have a long drive ahead this weekend and need the car to be perfectly safe for my family.
text_b: I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the Citroën attempt to exit the parking spot. The van driver moved quite aggressively, and the lady in the Citroën had to stop very abruptly. I heard a distinct sound, likely debris being kicked up, and then saw the crack appear on her windshield.

text_a: I was driving about 200 meters behind and saw the car hit the barrier. There were no other vehicles in the immediate vicinity at that time. It looked like a solo loss of control.
text_b: It was a bright afternoon in Setúbal. I was approaching the intersection on Avenida Luísa Todi. I thought the intersection was clear, but as I entered, a car came through from the right. We collided at a low angle. My front lamp is broken, and there is a dent on the wheel arch. I am really worried about how this will affect my insurance premiums. I have been driving for five years and never had a claim, so this is quite overwhelming for me, man.

text_a: The sunlight was reflecting intensely off the sand, which blinded me for a moment while I was backing out. I didn't see the bollard behind me until it was too late. I felt a hard jolt as my trunk made contact. When I checked, the plastic cover had a significant crack, and there's a visible dent on the bumper. I feel terrible about damaging the vehicle, but I am relieved that no other cars or pedestrians were involved in the mishap. It was a completely honest error on my part.
text_b: I saw the Hyundai reversing at a low speed toward the concrete bollard. The driver didn't seem to notice it. The impact caused a crack in the bumper and left a small dent on the rear frame.

text_a: I was proceeding through the green light at the intersection near the harbor. Another vehicle approached from the side street, seemingly failing to notice the red light. I tried to swerve, but we made contact. My front corner hit their side. The impact caused my headlight to shatter and left a large scratch across the bumper. It all happened within a split second. I was really shaken up, but thankfully neither of us was injured. I just want to make sure the insurance handles the repairs for the broken lamp and the paint damage correctly.
text_b: I was standing on the corner waiting to cross the street. The Nissan definitely had the green light. The other car didn't seem to slow down at all for the light. I saw the Nissan driver swerve right before the collision. It was quite a loud impact, and I saw parts of the headlight scatter on the asphalt.

text_a: I was maintaining a steady speed through the green light. Suddenly, this red motorcycle popped out from behind a parked delivery truck, creating a situation where I had to brake, and he just threw his bike under my bumper. It felt incredibly choreographed. He was wearing full safety gear and immediately began recording with his helmet camera. I have the feeling this whole incident was manufactured to extract a payout from my liability insurance. The damage is localized exactly where I expected it.
text_b: This driver was clearly distracted by his phone. He didn't even attempt to stop. I had to ditch the bike to avoid being crushed against the guardrail. I have injuries and my bike is a total write-off.

text_a: I was making a lane change on Avenida Lourenço Peixinho, trying to get to the next exit for the hospital. I thought I had enough space. I checked my mirror, but I guess I didn't see the Audi in my blind spot. I heard a scrape and felt the impact. It was my fault, I admit it. There's a long scratch and a dent on the side of the Audi.
text_b: Last night near the industrial park, a white commercial truck with no license plate visible forced me off the road into a concrete post. My headlight is completely shattered and the mounting bracket is destroyed. The other driver never even hesitated; they just sped off into the darkness toward the highway. I had to pay for a tow truck myself because the police were busy with another call. You absolutely must cover the total replacement of the lamp assembly and the bumper sensor suite.

text_a: I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio during the morning rush. I was in the middle lane and intended to exit towards the airport, but I think I might have drifted slightly. The other car was coming up on my right side and we made contact. It happened so fast. My front side panel now has a noticeable dent and my turn signal lamp is completely broken. I am really stressed about the insurance paperwork, as this is the first time I have ever been involved in an accident like this.
text_b: The driver of the Peugeot seemed to lose track of their lane while exiting the roundabout. I was staying in my lane, but they clipped my front fender. My lamp is broken and there is a visible dent on the metal bodywork. The driver was very polite despite being clearly shaken by the whole incident.

text_a: Driving North on the A1, a black sedan with foreign license plates cut directly across my path to exit the highway. I had no choice but to swerve into the side guardrail to avoid a massive pileup. The sedan driver did not even acknowledge me and just vanished into the distance. This resulted in a long scratch down the side of my vehicle. I need the insurance to cover this as a total write-off for my personal inconvenience.
text_b: I saw the Peugeot driver lose concentration and veer into the railing. There was no other traffic in that lane for at least 500 meters. The road was completely empty.

text_a: I was parked perfectly in the designated spot when a delivery truck reversed and scraped my left rear panel. The collision caused a massive dent, ruined the paint, and shattered the rear light fixture. The whole rear assembly is likely misaligned now too. This car is my pride and joy, and the repair costs are going to be astronomical because of these severe structural damages. I need the insurance adjuster to evaluate the vehicle immediately for a full replacement of the bumper and light system.
text_b: I clipped their bumper while parking because I misjudged the distance. I only caused a very faint, small scratch. The driver is making a massive deal out of a tiny scuff, even pointing at parts of the car that I definitely didn't touch.

text_a: At approximately 14:30 PM, I was operating my vehicle, a Peugeot 308, traveling westbound on Avenida da Boavista, Porto, in the middle lane. A vehicle, identified as a grey BMW 3 Series, initiated a lane change from the right lane without proper signalization or sufficient clearance, impacting the passenger side of my vehicle. The collision resulted in a superficial scratch extending approximately 40 centimeters and a minor dent on the front passenger door panel. My speed was maintained at 50 km/h, within the posted limit.
text_b: I was merging into the middle lane on Avenida da Boavista. I checked my mirrors, and I thought I had enough space, but I misjudged it. My car scraped against the side of the Peugeot. I apologize for the inconvenience. There's a clear scratch and a small dent on their car, and a minor scratch on my own.

text_a: I WAS DRIVING HOME ON RUA DO ANJO AROUND 23:00 LAST NIGHT. SOME IDIOT IN A DARK-COLOURED VAN, COULDN'T SEE THE PLATE, JUST SWERVED AND HIT MY CAR ON THE LEFT SIDE! HE DIDN'T EVEN STOP! THIS IS A HIT AND RUN! MY ENTIRE SIDE IS DENTED AND SCRATCHED! I NEED THIS FIXED IMMEDIATELY! IF THIS IS NOT PROCESSED BY TOMORROW, I AM CALLING MY LAWYER AND GOING TO THE LIVRO DE RECLAMAÇÕES! DO YOUR JOB!
text_b: I was pulling into a narrow street parking spot near the Baixa district. The sun was reflecting off the shop windows, which made it quite difficult to see exactly how close I was to the car parked in front of me. I thought I had cleared it, but I heard a scraping noise. I stepped out and found a scratch along my rear bumper. I feel terrible about it; I've never hit a parked car before and I'm honestly quite embarrassed by the whole situation.

text_a: I was driving home after a long shift at the office, heading down Avenida da Boavista around 6:30 PM. The traffic was quite heavy as usual, and suddenly the car ahead of me braked hard for a yellow light. I tried to press the brake, but I just couldn't stop in time on the damp road surface. My front bumper hit their rear bumper directly. I feel terrible about it, honestly, and I’m so worried about the repair costs since it’s my main car. There is a noticeable dent on the hood now.
text_b: I was stopped at the red light when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the other driver had hit me. I got out to check and noticed a clear dent on my rear bumper. We exchanged details calmly.

text_a: I WAS JUST TRYING TO LEAVE THE PARKING LOT AT THE RETAIL CENTER AND THIS IDIOT REVERSED RIGHT INTO MY DOOR! THE IMPACT WAS MASSIVE! MY CAR NOW HAS A HUGE DENT ON THE SIDE, AND THE FORCE WAS SO STRONG THAT MY REAR WINDOW HAS A COMPLETE GLASS SHATTER! THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE! I DEMAND THIS IS PAID IMMEDIATELY! IF YOU DELAY THIS CLAIM FOR EVEN ONE DAY, I AM GOING TO MY LAWYER AND WRITING IN THE LIVRO DE RECLAMAÇÕES!
text_b: I was loading groceries into my trunk nearby. The other car was reversing very slowly, maybe 2 or 3 km/h, and just grazed the side of the Seat Leon. It was a very light tap. I walked over to check if everyone was okay, and there was only a surface scratch on the Seat. Definitely no broken glass or huge dents. The Seat driver got out and immediately started screaming.

text_a: A bus scraped my left side while pulling into the stop. The paint transfer is visible, but the entire suspension system is now completely ruined as well. The car is pulling sharply to the right, and there is a clunking noise under the floor that started the second they hit me. I demand full replacement of the shocks and struts in addition to the bodywork repaint.
text_b: My bus clipped the Mini's side mirror and fender while maneuvering into the bay. It was a minor scratch, definitely not an impact strong enough to touch the suspension or the chassis mechanics.

text_a: It was a lovely afternoon, I remember, just after lunch, I was going to visit my friend Maria, she lives just past Praça do Giraldo, you know the one near the fountain? And I was turning left at the intersection, going slowly, maybe 15 km/h. But I misjudged the turn, you see, and there was a small green car, a Corsa I think, coming from the other side, and I just, well, I clipped his front. My front bumper has a dent now, and my front passenger window just shattered, it was quite a shock, I tell you! My heart was racing!
text_b: Man, it was so annoying, pá. I was just driving normally through Praça do Giraldo, like, totally within the speed limit, maybe 25 km/h. And this old lady, like, she just cut the corner super hard when she was turning left. She totally hit my front right side! My front bumper's got a huge dent now, and the headlight is cracked, which means it's probably broken. I'm so pissed, dude, this is gonna cost a fortune!

text_a: I was stopped at the red light when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The driver behind me couldn't stop in time. My rear bumper is scratched and dented from the contact, but luckily nobody was hurt in the collision. It was a standard urban accident, very unfortunate for both of us on a rainy morning in Porto.
text_b: I was proceeding through the intersection legally when the small car surged out from the left. I had no time to react and impacted their side. My car is totaled, and I demand immediate compensation for the injuries I sustained in the impact; get your insurance provider to settle this quickly.

text_a: I was attempting a reverse parking maneuver into a narrow spot. I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar and ended up scraping the rear bumper. I feel really foolish about it. There is a noticeable scratch and a minor dent on the corner. I have already taken photos as required and am ready to submit the claim.
text_b: I work at the cafe right next to the parking spot. I saw the Citroën reverse too quickly and strike the wall. The driver seemed distressed but took full responsibility, looking for the owner of the nearby cars to make sure they hadn't hit anyone else.

text_a: I was cruising along the Marginal road towards Estoril. The weather was beautiful, but the traffic was dense. I signaled to change lanes to my right, but as I started moving, another car emerged from my blind spot. We made side-to-side contact. I immediately pulled over to the shoulder. There is a deep scratch spanning both passenger doors. It happened so fast that I barely had time to react. I am just relieved that nobody was hurt, as the road was quite busy.
text_b: I was walking my dog on the sidewalk along the Marginal when I saw the two cars moving in the same direction. The blue car attempted to change lanes, but the dark grey vehicle was already moving up into the blind spot. They collided at a low speed, resulting in a visible scratch on the side of the Renault. Both drivers pulled over safely to exchange details.

text_a: I saw the Volvo in the outer lane of the roundabout. The taxi driver took the exit from the middle lane and didn't check his blind spot. The taxi's rear side hit the Volvo's front. It broke the lamp and left a large scratch on the bumper.
text_b: I was watching from my balcony. The road was completely empty. The Skoda driver was accelerating fast and simply hit the wall because he took the curve much too quickly. There was no other vehicle anywhere nearby.

text_a: I was stationary, waiting for a taxi to clear the lane, when a courier bike backed into me. The impact was violent. I now have a massive scratch, a shattered glass window, and a broken lamp. My vehicle's entire frame seems misaligned from the force of the collision. It's truly a tragedy as the car was in mint condition. The courier was incredibly rude and tried to leave, but I managed to snap a photo before he zoomed away.
text_b: The courier bike tapped the Opel very gently while maneuvering backward. There was maybe a tiny scratch on the bumper. The driver is definitely exaggerating about shattered glass and frame damage. The car looks perfectly fine.

text_a: While navigating the narrow turns of Rua das Flores, a white van abruptly appeared from a blind alleyway, forcing me to swerve right into a granite bollard. The van didn't even stop; it just sped off toward the river. I'm shaking because I had to decide between a head-on collision with that ghost driver or hitting the wall. The impact left this massive dent on the passenger door.
text_b: I was sitting at the cafe terrace right there. The driver of the Yaris just misjudged the turn and clipped the bollard at low speed. There was absolutely no other vehicle on this street at that time.

text_a: I was driving home from work along the waterfront when I reached the intersection. The light turned yellow, and I hesitated. The car behind me didn't anticipate the stop and nudged my rear end. It wasn't a high-speed collision, but my tail lamp is now broken, and there is a visible crack in the plastic housing. I am quite shaken up by the whole experience, as I have never been in an accident before. I just want to ensure everything is processed correctly through my insurance.
text_b: I stopped at the traffic light because it changed to orange. The driver behind me didn't stop in time and hit my rear. We both got out to check. There is a dent and scratch on his front bumper. He was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the whole process. We exchanged details without any issues.

text_a: I was driving down the avenue when a red sports car swerved into my lane without signaling. I slammed on the brakes, hit a stone planter, and cracked my headlight housing. The red car kept driving. I am absolutely furious about the lack of respect for traffic rules in this city; it is a miracle I didn't hit a pedestrian.
text_b: I was driving behind the Golf. I saw him hit the planter, but there was no red sports car in front of him. The road was entirely clear ahead. He just drifted into the sidewalk on his own.

text_a: I saw the whole thing from across the street. The driver tried to avoid a tourist who walked into the street without looking. The car hit the corner of a store frame. I saw the glass from the mirror shatter and a dent appeared on the side of the door. The driver was clearly trying to be careful.
text_b: I was navigating the roundabout, and honestly, the traffic was moving quite fast. I signaled to change lanes to exit towards the center of Porto, but I think I didn't check my blind spot well enough. I heard a loud noise and realized I had clipped another vehicle. My front lamp is broken, and there is a deep scratch along the side panel. It happened so fast, and I'm really shaken up by the whole experience. I just hope the other driver is okay, this has never happened to me before.

text_a: I was stationary at a stop sign when someone rolled into me. The impact was huge. My entire front end is destroyed, with a massive dent, a completely shattered headlight, and the windshield is cracked right down the middle. I am outraged by the negligence of the other driver. I expect the insurance company to cover the cost of a full engine inspection as well, because the chassis might be twisted from the intensity of the hit. I am absolutely shaken and require immediate assistance.
text_b: I was looking for a parking spot near the town hall. I started reversing slowly, thinking the way was clear behind me. I didn't see the post or the sign, and I backed into a concrete pillar on the sidewalk. It wasn't very fast, maybe 5 km/h, but it was enough to smash my rear lamp. I feel so bad because it's a rental car and I didn't want to cause any damage. I am just really stressed about the repair costs and the insurance paperwork process now.

text_a: I was cruising at 30 km/h through the intersection when this guy just slammed into my passenger side at high speed. It was totally unprovoked. The impact was so violent that my entire side frame is warped, and I am certain the chassis is bent beyond repair. I have already contacted my lawyer, and I demand you process this claim without any delays because I know exactly how these systems work.
text_b: I was waiting at the yield sign and saw him accelerate directly into me. He didn't even try to swerve. His passenger door has a small dent.

text_a: We were both moving at a walking pace when our bumpers grazed. I barely felt anything. There is just a tiny scratch on the plastic trim of both vehicles. His description of a violent impact is completely false.
text_b: I was leaving the roundabout. I think the other car was too fast. We just touched. My car has a tiny scratch on the side. Nothing serious. His car looked like it had a scratch too, but I didn't see any other damage.

text_a: I parked neatly in a designated bay near the theater. When I returned, the bumper of my car was completely pulverized, the headlight housing was shattered into pieces, and there were deep gouges along the entire side panel. It looks like a heavy delivery truck smashed into it while parking and just drove away. The repair costs are going to be astronomical; this car is my pride and joy.
text_b: I saw someone tap the bumper while parallel parking earlier. It was a light touch. There was maybe a small scratch, definitely not the damage the owner is describing.

text_a: The lights turned green exactly at 08:32 AM. I proceeded cautiously, but a silver hatchback surged forward from the side street, intentionally colliding with my front passenger door at a perfect ninety-degree angle. It was highly bizarre how calculated the impact felt, almost as if he wanted the contact right there. I have dashcam footage prepared. The collision caused an immediate dent which I noticed while we were both exchanging our details immediately after the impact occurred.
text_b: I was moving through the crossing when the Seat simply turned into my path. It was a clear-cut case of them cutting me off. I did not see any other vehicles involved at the scene, just us.

text_a: I was navigating the roundabout at the Rotunda do Relógio when another driver cut me off aggressively. They clipped my side, and now my entire door panel is smashed in and the frame looks bent. The other driver sped off without even checking if I was okay, it’s completely unfair that I have to deal with all this structural repair now.
text_b: I saw two cars jostling for position on the roundabout. There was a brief contact near the lane divider. It looked like a minor paint transfer, definitely just a cosmetic scratch to the rear fender.

text_a: Some blue car swerved in front of me and forced me to hit the curb. There are deep scratches on my alloy wheels and side trim. I tried to follow the car but it sped off onto the A1. I didn't catch the license plate but there should be cameras everywhere in Gaia, please check them immediately to find this hit and run driver.
text_b: I saw the Toyota hit the curb. The driver was looking at their phone and just drifted onto the sidewalk. There were absolutely no other cars on the road during that entire stretch. He was alone.

text_a: I was driving perfectly straight through the green light. Out of nowhere, this driver surged across my front bumper without looking. It felt like they wanted to be hit. I have a dashcam, but the file is corrupted for some reason, which is incredibly unlucky, but I have a pedestrian witness who saw the whole thing and is willing to testify that I had the right of way.
text_b: I was just waiting for the bus when I saw the Renault driving normally. The other car suddenly turned left in front of it. It was clearly the fault of the driver who turned; the Renault didn't have time to brake. I made sure to stick around to support the driver who was in the right.

text_a: I feel so foolish. I was trying to parallel park near the center of Coimbra under the rain, and I completely misjudged the distance to the wall. My car slipped slightly on the wet cobblestones and I heard that awful grinding noise of metal against stone. There is a deep scratch along the rear passenger side panel now. I'm quite stressed because this is a new vehicle and I'm not sure how long the repair will take or what the excess fee will be.
text_b: I watched the driver attempting to maneuver into the parking space. It was very tight and the rain was heavy, making visibility poor. She turned the wheel too early and scraped the side against the corner of the stone wall. I was right there to help her pull over safely afterward.

text_a: At approximately 14:30, while proceeding westbound on Avenida da Liberdade, approaching the intersection with Rua Barata Salgueiro, I initiated a left turn. Concurrently, a vehicle traveling eastbound proceeded directly through the intersection. My assessment indicates a failure by the opposing driver to yield. Impact occurred to my front-right quadrant. Observable damages include a significant dent to the front right fender, a shattered headlight assembly, and substantial scratching across the entire front quarter panel. My vehicle was traveling at an estimated 25 km/h at the point of impact.
text_b: I was going straight on Avenida da Liberdade. The other driver turned left directly in front of me without proper clearance. I had the right of way. My front bumper is dented and scratched. The impact was unavoidable. My speed was about 30 km/h.

text_a: I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM. The traffic on Avenida da Boavista was quite heavy as usual. I was moving slowly, maybe 20 km/h, when the car in front suddenly slammed on the brakes because a pedestrian stepped onto the crossing. I tried to stop, but I just couldn't manage to react in time and tapped their rear bumper. It was entirely my fault, and I feel terrible about the dent it caused to their trunk. I just hope the other driver is okay.
text_b: I was stopped at the designated pedestrian crossing when I felt a significant jolt from behind. I checked my rearview mirror and saw a Golf had failed to brake in time. My bumper is dented, but thankfully, there is no other damage to speak of.

text_a: I was standing near the roundabout observing traffic. The Polo driver was forced into a sharp turn by a reckless entry from another vehicle. I saw him hit the curb while trying to avoid the other car. There is a visible crack on his front wheel hubcap from the impact.
text_b: I was standing on the corner waiting to cross the road. The Citroën went through the intersection just as the light was changing and hit the other vehicle passing by. It sounded like glass shattering when the mirrors collided. It all happened very quickly.

text_a: The traffic was at a complete standstill due to the rush hour congestion. I was at a full stop for several seconds before I felt a jolt from behind. The driver behind me didn't brake early enough. We both exited our vehicles to exchange information. I noticed damage on the rear bumper, specifically a dent where the impact occurred and some scratches along the plastic molding.
text_b: I was trying to park my car in a narrow spot on Rua Augusta. I thought I had enough clearance, but as I was reversing, I turned the wheel too early and clipped the side of the vehicle parked next to me. I immediately got out to check. It caused a visible dent and a long scratch on the rear quarter panel of my own car. I feel so embarrassed because it was a completely avoidable mistake on my part while trying to fit into a tight space.

text_a: It was a busy afternoon on the N125. The car in front of me braked hard for a turning vehicle, and although I tried to avoid contact, my front bumper tapped their rear. There is only a light surface scratch, but the driver is claiming I shattered his entire rear lighting array and caused whiplash requiring physiotherapy. It feels like he is trying to exploit the situation for a much higher payout.
text_b: The force was enormous! My head snapped back instantly, and my back has been in agony ever since. Beyond the major damage to my rear lamps and trunk, I have extensive medical costs that the insurance must cover immediately. This was gross negligence on his part.

text_a: I was moving through the taxi lane near Praça do Comércio. A delivery scooter stopped suddenly to avoid a pedestrian, and I had to brake really hard. The car behind me didn't have enough reaction time and hit my rear end. It was quite a jolt. The force shattered my rear glass and pushed the bumper in, causing a large dent. It’s been a very long day, and honestly, this is the last thing I wanted to deal with. The other driver and I are waiting for the police report to be finalized now.
text_b: The traffic stopped abruptly because of a scooter. I was driving too close, and I couldn't stop in time. I hit the back of the Mercedes. I can see the rear glass is shattered and there is a dent in his bumper. I am taking full responsibility for the accident.

text_a: I had come to a complete stop at the zebra crossing on Avenida da Boavista when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. It was a low-speed impact, but it was enough to cause visible damage to my rear bumper. The other driver was quite shaken and admitted immediately that he had been distracted for a split second.
text_b: I was in the vehicle behind the Volvo. I saw the driver lose control while trying to change lanes at high speed. There was no truck or any other vehicle involved in the maneuver.

text_a: Everything happened so quickly. I was holding my lane steady on the A1 heading north when this dark sedan aggressively swerved into my path, forcing me into the concrete divider. The contact was absolutely violent, a loud metal-on-metal screech that sent sparks everywhere. It clearly caused extensive frame warping and deep structural damage across the entire side of my chassis. I barely managed to keep the car from spinning out.
text_b: I was driving about fifty meters behind the Audi. There was no other vehicle around the driver at the time of the collision with the wall. The road was relatively clear during that morning commute.

text_a: It was raining heavily near the airport roundabout. Traffic was crawling, and as I tried to merge into the inner circle, my foot slipped off the brake pedal. I bumped gently into the bumper of the car ahead of me. I felt terrible immediately, as I'm still getting used to driving in such busy traffic in Lisbon.
text_b: We were moving at barely walking pace. Suddenly, the Yaris behind me just rolled forward and knocked into my rear bumper. The driver was very apologetic and visibly shaking from the stress of the situation.

text_a: I was trying to park in a tight spot near the university. I was moving very slowly, maybe at 5 km/h, but I underestimated the distance to the concrete pillar in the garage. I scraped against the side, and then my bumper hit the base of the pillar. There is a visible scratch and a small dent now. I am so embarrassed; I was just trying to get to my appointment on time and I wasn't paying enough attention to my surroundings. It was completely my fault and I just want to handle the repairs properly.
text_b: The traffic on Avenida 24 de Julho was extremely heavy today near the docks. I was crawling along, maybe at 10 km/h, when the delivery truck to my left started drifting into my lane. There wasn't much space to move over, so they caught my side panel. It left a deep scratch running down the length of the passenger door. It's really frustrating, man, because I just had the car cleaned yesterday. I hope the insurance covers this efficiently because I can't afford to be without a car for too long, you know?

text_a: My grandson and I were heading to the bakery, just a lovely morning until the incident. I stopped for a pedestrian crossing near the old center, and the lady behind me was likely distracted by her phone. She hit the back of my car quite hard. It smashed my rear tail light, so the lamp is broken now. I am a bit shaken as I am getting on in years, but thank goodness no one was hurt in the process.
text_b: I was driving along the Marginal road towards Cascais, enjoying the coastal view, and I decided to move to the right lane to exit. The sun was quite bright, and I suppose I missed the car coming up on my side. I heard a loud noise and pulled over right away. My indicator lamp is broken, and there is a deep scratch along the side panel. I am just really stressed about the repair process, man, I hope the insurance covers most of it.

text_a: I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around midday. I wanted to move from the middle lane to the right lane. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot. As I started to shift, we made contact. It wasn't a hard hit, but there is a noticeable dent and a long scratch on the rear passenger door. I am a professional who values efficiency, so I am reporting this promptly to ensure we get the paperwork sorted without any unnecessary delays.
text_b: I had gone into the city center to pick up some items for my sister's birthday, and I was trying to park in a very tight spot on Rua de Santa Catarina. I was going slow, maybe 5 km/h, but I turned the wheel too early and miscalculated the angle against the car parked next to me. It was such a silly mistake. Now my front corner has a scratch and a small dent. I feel really embarrassed about the whole situation because it was entirely my fault.

text_a: While exiting the parking garage, a delivery van grazed my side. The impact caused massive structural damage to my entire left side and shattered all the glass panels along the door. I am shocked by how expensive this repair will be, as the whole frame is clearly misaligned. The van driver didn't even stop, but I managed to note the license plate. My vehicle is completely ruined and I expect a full replacement cost immediately, as it is no longer safe to operate on these steep streets.
text_b: I was walking my dog nearby when I saw the Yaris nudge the concrete pillar of the garage entrance. There was no van involved. It made a small scraping sound against the wall, leaving only a minor surface mark on the paintwork.

text_a: A black SUV with no lights on cut me off violently near the intersection, forcing me to swerve into the stone wall to avoid a head-on crash. If I hadn't hit the wall, I would have died. The SUV sped away instantly without stopping, leaving me to deal with the aftermath. My car has huge cracks in the bumper, major glass shatters, and deep dents across the entire passenger side. I need the insurance company to prioritize this claim immediately because I have no way to get to work.
text_b: I was walking nearby and heard the impact. I saw the car hit the wall, but there were no other vehicles on the road at that moment. The street was completely empty.

text_a: I was carefully reversing out of my parking spot near the beach. My sensors didn't pick up the low-lying bollard, and I grazed it. There is definitely a deep scratch, and I fear the entire rear panel is dented and the tail lamp assembly is cracked inside. It's going to be a very costly repair for such a minor-looking maneuver.
text_b: I watched the Fiat reverse and hit the metal post. It only made a slight scraping sound. I walked over later, and honestly, it looks like a simple surface mark that would buff right out.

text_a: I had parked my car near the campus while I went to pick up my daughter. When I came back, there was a note on my windshield saying someone had bumped into me. The rear bumper has a large dent and the tail lamp is broken. I feel so frustrated, man, it's just really unfair that someone can hit your car and you aren't even there to prevent it. I don't know who did it, but the damage is pretty obvious, and it’s going to be a real pain to get it repaired this month.
text_b: I saw a delivery truck backing up in the parking lot. The driver clearly misjudged the turning radius and hit the parked Nissan. I saw the driver get out, write a note, place it on the windshield, and then drive away. I noted the license plate if you need it.

text_a: A white sports car overtook me and cut me off dangerously near the Loulé exit. I steered sharply to avoid contact and ended up scraping against the road sign pillar. There is a deep scratch along the passenger side. I couldn't see the license plate of the car that caused this incident because of the dust.
text_b: There was no other car on the road. The driver just drifted into the signs while looking down at his phone. I was right behind him, and the road was completely empty for at least a kilometer.

text_a: I WAS OBEYING THE TRAFFIC LAWS ON RUA DE SANTA CATARINA! I HAD THE RIGHT OF WAY! THIS OTHER CAR, A FIAT 500, PULLED OUT WITHOUT WARNING! MY ENTIRE SIDE IS DESTROYED! THE HEADLAMP IS GONE, WINDOWS SHATTERED, HUGE DENTS! THIS IS A COMPLETE WRITE-OFF! I DEMAND THIS CLAIM BE PROCESSED IMMEDIATELY AND PAID IN FULL! I HAVE LAWYERS ON STANDBY!
text_b: I observed the incident from a nearby cafe at approximately 16:15. A Fiat 500, attempting to turn left, failed to yield to a Mercedes A-Class. The impact was not high-velocity; it appeared to be a fender-bender. I noted a dent and some scratches on the Mercedes' passenger side. The driver of the Mercedes appeared quite agitated, but I did not observe any glass shatter or a broken headlamp on their vehicle at the scene.

text_a: I entered the intersection at Praça Marquês de Pombal on the green light, or at least I thought it was green. The car coming from the perpendicular road moved forward too early. We collided at a low speed. It was really chaotic with all the tourists and pedestrians around. There is a long scratch along my driver-side door where we made contact. I am just so anxious about how this will affect my insurance premiums, you know? It happened so fast I can barely remember the exact timing of the traffic signal.
text_b: I was walking near the metro station entrance and saw the incident. The Ford driver entered the intersection just as the light was turning yellow. The other vehicle didn't wait for the clear signal and pulled out. They hit each other's side panels. It wasn't high speed, but they definitely scratched each other's paint quite badly. It was just an unfortunate mistake by both parties.

text_a: I was working in the warehouse facing the road all morning. I saw the Renault driver lose control while taking the turn too fast and hitting the bollard, but no other car was involved. They have been trying to make up stories about phantom SUVs all afternoon.
text_b: I was walking to my own car when I saw a silver sedan backing into the parked Renault. The driver of the sedan didn't seem to notice or just didn't care, because they pulled away quite quickly after the contact. I inspected the Renault and clearly saw a crack in the bumper. I stayed around because I knew the owner would be upset to find such damage.

text_a: I was moving through the residential zone when the other car deliberately drove into the wrong lane to block my path. It was a precise, controlled crash.
